# gh-1684: [BUG] Pages deploy blocked: fa-extension.zip size budget +230% after #1631 vendored engines (litert/transformers/webllm)

## Description

### Bug

Pages deploy is red: the "Build landing + web demo" job fails at **Size manifest + budget gate (#1096 AC1)** — `build/fa-extension.zip` regressed **TOTAL-1P +230.3%** (35.7MB → 117.9MB first-party; raw 73.3MB → 155.5MB).

Root cause: PR #1631 ("vendor all CDN engines locally") added on-device inference vendor bundles to the extension build — the gate's NEW-entry lines name them exactly:

- `vendor/litert/0.12.1/litertlm_wasm_compat_internal.wasm` (18.8MB) + `litertlm_wasm_internal.wasm` (18.9MB)
- `vendor/transformers/4.2.0/ort-wasm-simd-threaded{,.asyncify}.wasm` (12.9MB + 23.6MB)
- `vendor/webllm/0.2.84/webllm.mjs` (6.1MB)

Example failure: run 39116173117, job 117642302659 (Pages on gh-1670). Every Pages run since #1631 merged fails the same way.

### Context (mapped 2026-10-18)

- `fa-extension.zip` is **not** in GH release assets (v1.0.600: CLI bundles + fa-web-spa.zip only) — Pages (fa1.dev/extension/fa-extension.zip) is the ONLY public download channel today, linked from site/index.html (4 places) + site/llms.txt (2 places) as the documented sideload install path. CWS channel is not live yet (#1631 fixed the rejection; vendoring all engines locally was forced by store policy — that's where the +230% comes from, intentional).
- The same zip is size-gated in build-macos.yml against the SAME committed baseline — yet releases v1.0.599/600 went green while Pages is red: the legs diverged (build flags or a skipped gate). Investigate as part of this fix.

### Owner decision (2026-10-18) — direction locked

1. **Move fa-extension.zip to GH Releases** as a release asset; site links switch to `https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/releases/latest/download/fa-extension.zip` (update site/index.html ×4 + site/llms.txt ×2 in the same PR). Pages stops carrying/copying the zip (drop the assemble-step copy + the Pages size-gate leg for the zip).
2. **The size gate moves to PR review time** (quality-gates job in ci.yml): build the extension zip (or a fast manifest-only variant) on PRs that touch extension sources/vendor and fail the PR on budget regression — the problem must surface at review, not at deployment.
3. Reseed `scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv` to the post-#1631 shape in the same PR (the vendored engines are intentional — CWS policy).
4. Make the build-macos.yml and (new) PR gates symmetric — one baseline, one enforcement rule; resolve why the release leg was green while Pages was red.
5. Never-again: arm or remove the notice-only web-app.tsv/outlook-app.tsv gates (their baselines were never committed — they have been notice-only since #1096).

### Acceptance criteria

1. Pages deploys green; the Pages artifact no longer contains fa-extension.zip; the site's extension download links point at the GH release asset.
2. fa-extension.zip is attached to releases (latest tag onward).
3. The extension size gate runs in PR CI (quality-gates) against the reseeded baseline; a vendor-bump PR without a reseed fails red at review time.
4. web-app.tsv + outlook-app.tsv baselines committed and armed, or the legs removed.
5. The macos/PR gate symmetry question answered in the PR description.

### Evidence

- Failing job log: run 39116173117 / job 117642302659, step "Size manifest + budget gate (#1096 AC1)", `##[error]size budget regression in build/fa-extension.zip (6 line(s) beyond +5.0%)`.
- Introducing change: #1631 (merged).

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1693
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1693
- **Title**: gh-1684 [BUG] Pages deploy blocked: fa-extension.zip size budget +230% after #1631 vendored engines (litert/transformers/webllm)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1684` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 13
- **Additions**: +542
- **Deletions**: -125
- **Created**: 2026-10-18T13:11:23Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-18T16:29:16Z

## PR Description

Closes #1684
## gh-1684 — Pages deploy blocked: fa-extension.zip size budget +230% after #1631

### Root Cause
- #1631's vendored on-device engines (litert/transformers/webllm) are intentional (gh-1630 CWS no-remote-code policy), but the size floor was never reseeded and the only gate was deploy-time in `pages.yml` — the regression surfaced after merge and blocked Pages (run 39116173117: `TOTAL-1P +230.3%`, 6 lines beyond +5.0%).

### Fix
- **Download channel (AC1/AC2)**: `fa-extension.zip` moves to GitHub Releases. `site/index.html` (5 link/text occurrences incl. the FAQ JSON-LD) + `site/llms.txt` (×2) now point at `releases/latest/download/fa-extension.zip`; the per-release JS rewrite is gone (static href IS the release). `pages.yml` no longer builds/copies/gates the zip; `build-macos.yml` build-extension keeps attaching it to releases (gate-before-upload).
- **Gate at review time (AC3)**: new `extension-size-gate` leg in `ci.yml` — builds the real zip (`--with-app`, Flutter 3.47.7) on extension/app/core/vendor/baseline/workflow-touching PRs + SM validation dispatches, fails the PR against the committed baseline; wired into `quality-gate` (platform class, skipped = pass). A vendor-bump PR without a reseed goes red at review.
- **Reseed (decision 3)**: `scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv` reseeded to the post-#1631 shape (42 rows, TOTAL 155,539,998) from a zip built with the pinned SDK.
- **Never-again (AC4)**: notice-only `web-app.tsv`/`outlook-app.tsv` legs (baselines never committed since #1096) removed from Pages rather than armed.
- **Symmetry (AC5)**: release leg + PR leg + (retired Pages leg) share one baseline, one `size_manifest.py check` invocation, one Flutter 3.47.7 pin — build-macos's old unpinned `channel: stable` pinned.

### macos/PR gate symmetry — why releases looked green (AC5)
The release extension gate was red too (same 6 lines; `fa-extension.zip` absent from v1.0.600 assets). The release *object* still shipped because the tag-cut (`auto_release.sh`) creates it and sibling jobs attach assets without needing the extension job (`release-macos` needs only `[version, build-macos]`; CLI/web-spa legs race-safe `gh release create || true`). Fixed structurally: the PR gate now catches regressions before merge, so the release leg can't be the first alarm.

### Test Coverage
- RED repro: gate vs old baseline fails with the exact ticket signature (+230.3%, 6 lines, 73.3→155.5MB raw). GREEN: reseeded baseline passes (+0.0%); `size_manifest.py selftest` PASS; `scripts/test_size_manifest.py` OK.
- New wiring guard `test/ci_1684_extension_size_gate_test.dart` (17 tests); legacy guards (ci_1267, ci_1659, pub-get-retry, dispatch-watch, site llms/appstore, browser_ext shape) updated + green — 125 tests.

### Notes
- AC4 chose **remove** over arm (owner decision allows either): deploy-time gates are the wrong layer, and a baseline generated from a differently-flagged build would false-red.
- Pages trigger paths dropped `browser_ext/**` (nothing extension-related deploys anymore); website-leg watch budget (60m worst-case) only shrinks.

# gh-1684: [BUG] Pages deploy blocked: fa-extension.zip size budget +230% after #1631 vendored engines (litert/transformers/webllm)

## Description

### Bug

Pages deploy is red: the "Build landing + web demo" job fails at **Size manifest + budget gate (#1096 AC1)** — `build/fa-extension.zip` regressed **TOTAL-1P +230.3%** (35.7MB → 117.9MB first-party; raw 73.3MB → 155.5MB).

Root cause: PR #1631 ("vendor all CDN engines locally") added on-device inference vendor bundles to the extension build — the gate's NEW-entry lines name them exactly:

- `vendor/litert/0.12.1/litertlm_wasm_compat_internal.wasm` (18.8MB) + `litertlm_wasm_internal.wasm` (18.9MB)
- `vendor/transformers/4.2.0/ort-wasm-simd-threaded{,.asyncify}.wasm` (12.9MB + 23.6MB)
- `vendor/webllm/0.2.84/webllm.mjs` (6.1MB)

Example failure: run 39116173117, job 117642302659 (Pages on gh-1670). Every Pages run since #1631 merged fails the same way.

### Context (mapped 2026-10-18)

- `fa-extension.zip` is **not** in GH release assets (v1.0.600: CLI bundles + fa-web-spa.zip only) — Pages (fa1.dev/extension/fa-extension.zip) is the ONLY public download channel today, linked from site/index.html (4 places) + site/llms.txt (2 places) as the documented sideload install path. CWS channel is not live yet (#1631 fixed the rejection; vendoring all engines locally was forced by store policy — that's where the +230% comes from, intentional).
- The same zip is size-gated in build-macos.yml against the SAME committed baseline — yet releases v1.0.599/600 went green while Pages is red: the legs diverged (build flags or a skipped gate). Investigate as part of this fix.

### Owner decision (2026-10-18) — direction locked

1. **Move fa-extension.zip to GH Releases** as a release asset; site links switch to `https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/releases/latest/download/fa-extension.zip` (update site/index.html ×4 + site/llms.txt ×2 in the same PR). Pages stops carrying/copying the zip (drop the assemble-step copy + the Pages size-gate leg for the zip).
2. **The size gate moves to PR review time** (quality-gates job in ci.yml): build the extension zip (or a fast manifest-only variant) on PRs that touch extension sources/vendor and fail the PR on budget regression — the problem must surface at review, not at deployment.
3. Reseed `scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv` to the post-#1631 shape in the same PR (the vendored engines are intentional — CWS policy).
4. Make the build-macos.yml and (new) PR gates symmetric — one baseline, one enforcement rule; resolve why the release leg was green while Pages was red.
5. Never-again: arm or remove the notice-only web-app.tsv/outlook-app.tsv gates (their baselines were never committed — they have been notice-only since #1096).

### Acceptance criteria

1. Pages deploys green; the Pages artifact no longer contains fa-extension.zip; the site's extension download links point at the GH release asset.
2. fa-extension.zip is attached to releases (latest tag onward).
3. The extension size gate runs in PR CI (quality-gates) against the reseeded baseline; a vendor-bump PR without a reseed fails red at review time.
4. web-app.tsv + outlook-app.tsv baselines committed and armed, or the legs removed.
5. The macos/PR gate symmetry question answered in the PR description.

### Evidence

- Failing job log: run 39116173117 / job 117642302659, step "Size manifest + budget gate (#1096 AC1)", `##[error]size budget regression in build/fa-extension.zip (6 line(s) beyond +5.0%)`.
- Introducing change: #1631 (merged).

- **PR #**: 1693
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1693
- **Title**: gh-1684 [BUG] Pages deploy blocked: fa-extension.zip size budget +230% after #1631 vendored engines (litert/transformers/webllm)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1684` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 13
- **Additions**: +542
- **Deletions**: -125
- **Created**: 2026-10-18T13:11:23Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-18T16:29:16Z

## PR Description

Closes #1684
## gh-1684 — Pages deploy blocked: fa-extension.zip size budget +230% after #1631

### Root Cause
- #1631's vendored on-device engines (litert/transformers/webllm) are intentional (gh-1630 CWS no-remote-code policy), but the size floor was never reseeded and the only gate was deploy-time in `pages.yml` — the regression surfaced after merge and blocked Pages (run 39116173117: `TOTAL-1P +230.3%`, 6 lines beyond +5.0%).

### Fix
- **Download channel (AC1/AC2)**: `fa-extension.zip` moves to GitHub Releases. `site/index.html` (5 link/text occurrences incl. the FAQ JSON-LD) + `site/llms.txt` (×2) now point at `releases/latest/download/fa-extension.zip`; the per-release JS rewrite is gone (static href IS the release). `pages.yml` no longer builds/copies/gates the zip; `build-macos.yml` build-extension keeps attaching it to releases (gate-before-upload).
- **Gate at review time (AC3)**: new `extension-size-gate` leg in `ci.yml` — builds the real zip (`--with-app`, Flutter 3.47.7) on extension/app/core/vendor/baseline/workflow-touching PRs + SM validation dispatches, fails the PR against the committed baseline; wired into `quality-gate` (platform class, skipped = pass). A vendor-bump PR without a reseed goes red at review.
- **Reseed (decision 3)**: `scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv` reseeded to the post-#1631 shape (42 rows, TOTAL 155,539,998) from a zip built with the pinned SDK.
- **Never-again (AC4)**: notice-only `web-app.tsv`/`outlook-app.tsv` legs (baselines never committed since #1096) removed from Pages rather than armed.
- **Symmetry (AC5)**: release leg + PR leg + (retired Pages leg) share one baseline, one `size_manifest.py check` invocation, one Flutter 3.47.7 pin — build-macos's old unpinned `channel: stable` pinned.

### macos/PR gate symmetry — why releases looked green (AC5)
The release extension gate was red too (same 6 lines; `fa-extension.zip` absent from v1.0.600 assets). The release *object* still shipped because the tag-cut (`auto_release.sh`) creates it and sibling jobs attach assets without needing the extension job (`release-macos` needs only `[version, build-macos]`; CLI/web-spa legs race-safe `gh release create || true`). Fixed structurally: the PR gate now catches regressions before merge, so the release leg can't be the first alarm.

### Test Coverage
- RED repro: gate vs old baseline fails with the exact ticket signature (+230.3%, 6 lines, 73.3→155.5MB raw). GREEN: reseeded baseline passes (+0.0%); `size_manifest.py selftest` PASS; `scripts/test_size_manifest.py` OK.
- New wiring guard `test/ci_1684_extension_size_gate_test.dart` (17 tests); legacy guards (ci_1267, ci_1659, pub-get-retry, dispatch-watch, site llms/appstore, browser_ext shape) updated + green — 125 tests.

### Notes
- AC4 chose **remove** over arm (owner decision allows either): deploy-time gates are the wrong layer, and a baseline generated from a differently-flagged build would false-red.
- Pages trigger paths dropped `browser_ext/**` (nothing extension-related deploys anymore); website-leg watch budget (60m worst-case) only shrinks.
- Full `dart test` suite result is reported by CI; the touched suites above pass locally.

# gh-1684: [BUG] Pages deploy blocked: fa-extension.zip size budget +230% after #1631 vendored engines (litert/transformers/webllm)

## Description

### Bug

Pages deploy is red: the "Build landing + web demo" job fails at **Size manifest + budget gate (#1096 AC1)** — `build/fa-extension.zip` regressed **TOTAL-1P +230.3%** (35.7MB → 117.9MB first-party; raw 73.3MB → 155.5MB).

Root cause: PR #1631 ("vendor all CDN engines locally") added on-device inference vendor bundles to the extension build — the gate's NEW-entry lines name them exactly:

- `vendor/litert/0.12.1/litertlm_wasm_compat_internal.wasm` (18.8MB) + `litertlm_wasm_internal.wasm` (18.9MB)
- `vendor/transformers/4.2.0/ort-wasm-simd-threaded{,.asyncify}.wasm` (12.9MB + 23.6MB)
- `vendor/webllm/0.2.84/webllm.mjs` (6.1MB)

Example failure: run 39116173117, job 117642302659 (Pages on gh-1670). Every Pages run since #1631 merged fails the same way.

### Context (mapped 2026-10-18)

- `fa-extension.zip` is **not** in GH release assets (v1.0.600: CLI bundles + fa-web-spa.zip only) — Pages (fa1.dev/extension/fa-extension.zip) is the ONLY public download channel today, linked from site/index.html (4 places) + site/llms.txt (2 places) as the documented sideload install path. CWS channel is not live yet (#1631 fixed the rejection; vendoring all engines locally was forced by store policy — that's where the +230% comes from, intentional).
- The same zip is size-gated in build-macos.yml against the SAME committed baseline — yet releases v1.0.599/600 went green while Pages is red: the legs diverged (build flags or a skipped gate). Investigate as part of this fix.

### Owner decision (2026-10-18) — direction locked

1. **Move fa-extension.zip to GH Releases** as a release asset; site links switch to `https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/releases/latest/download/fa-extension.zip` (update site/index.html ×4 + site/llms.txt ×2 in the same PR). Pages stops carrying/copying the zip (drop the assemble-step copy + the Pages size-gate leg for the zip).
2. **The size gate moves to PR review time** (quality-gates job in ci.yml): build the extension zip (or a fast manifest-only variant) on PRs that touch extension sources/vendor and fail the PR on budget regression — the problem must surface at review, not at deployment.
3. Reseed `scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv` to the post-#1631 shape in the same PR (the vendored engines are intentional — CWS policy).
4. Make the build-macos.yml and (new) PR gates symmetric — one baseline, one enforcement rule; resolve why the release leg was green while Pages was red.
5. Never-again: arm or remove the notice-only web-app.tsv/outlook-app.tsv gates (their baselines were never committed — they have been notice-only since #1096).

### Acceptance criteria

1. Pages deploys green; the Pages artifact no longer contains fa-extension.zip; the site's extension download links point at the GH release asset.
2. fa-extension.zip is attached to releases (latest tag onward).
3. The extension size gate runs in PR CI (quality-gates) against the reseeded baseline; a vendor-bump PR without a reseed fails red at review time.
4. web-app.tsv + outlook-app.tsv baselines committed and armed, or the legs removed.
5. The macos/PR gate symmetry question answered in the PR description.

### Evidence

- Failing job log: run 39116173117 / job 117642302659, step "Size manifest + budget gate (#1096 AC1)", `##[error]size budget regression in build/fa-extension.zip (6 line(s) beyond +5.0%)`.
- Introducing change: #1631 (merged).

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,

All required context — ticket description, PR diff, CI status, and related materials — has already been prepared in the `input/` folder. Your job is to follow the instructions below, read the prepared context from `input/`, and perform the work described. Do not ask for identifiers; the context is already available locally. ```mermaid flowchart TD G1["⚠️ Review Guidelines — evaluate against existing codebase patterns"] G2["Before reviewing, explore the project's code structure, architecture, and testing patterns"] G3["If AGENTS.md exists → READ it — defines coding styles to check against"] G4["Flag deviations from established patterns unless justified in PR description"] G1 --> G2 --> G3 --> G4 ``` # PR Review General Guidelines ## Review flow ```mermaid flowchart TD START([PR ready for review]) --> READ["1. Read input context:
instruction.md, ticket.md, pr_info.md,
pr_diff.txt, pr_files.txt, ci_failures.md,
ci_failures_full.log, pr_discussions.md,
pr_discussions_raw.json"] READ --> DIFF["2. Run diff checklist on pr_diff.txt"] DIFF --> FILES["3. Read full content of every changed file"] FILES --> CODEGRAPH["4. Use CodeGraph:
callers/callees of changed symbols,
search for sensitive patterns,
impact analysis"] CODEGRAPH --> DIMS["5. Evaluate review dimensions:
Security · Architecture/OOP · Code quality
Test coverage · Duplication · Backward compatibility"] DIMS --> SEVERITY["6. Classify each finding:
BLOCKING / IMPORTANT / SUGGESTION"] SEVERITY --> EXHAUST["7. Exhaustive pass:
re-read changed files,
surface ALL remaining issues"] EXHAUST --> OUTPUT["8. Write outputs:
pr_review.json · pr_review_general.md · pr_review_comments/*.md"] OUTPUT --> END([End]) ``` ## 1. Input context — MANDATORY reading order ```mermaid flowchart TD subgraph PR_CONTEXT["⚠️ PR-specific files (read first)"] P1["1️⃣ instruction.md (repo root) — project stack, conventions"] P2["2️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_info.md — PR title, author, branch, description"] P3["3️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_diff.txt — the diff to review"] P4["4️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_files.txt — list of changed files"] P5["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures.md — CI failures = BLOCKING (last 500 lines)"] P5_FULL["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures_full.log — full CI logs"] P6["6️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_discussions.md + pr_discussions_raw.json — existing comments"] P1 --> P2 --> P3 --> P4 --> P5 --> P5_FULL --> P6 end subgraph TICKET_CONTEXT["Ticket context (for understanding PR purpose)"] T1["7️⃣ input/TICKET/ticket.md — linked ticket description, ACs"] T2["8️⃣ input/TICKET/comments.md — ticket discussion if present"] T3["9️⃣ input/TICKET/parent-*.md — parent story context"] T4["🔟 input/TICKET/confluence/*.md — linked specifications"] T1 --> T2 --> T3 --> T4 end subgraph RULE["⚠️ Rule"] R1["If file exists in input/ → read locally, do NOT re-fetch via dmtools"] end PR_CONTEXT --> TICKET_CONTEXT --> RULE ``` Read PR files to understand WHAT changed. Read ticket files to understand WHY it changed and verify against requirements. ## 2. Diff checklist — apply to `pr_diff.txt` For every hunk, ask at least these questions: - [ ] Does the change match the ticket scope? Any scope creep? - [ ] Are new or changed public APIs contract-safe for existing callers? - [ ] Is user/external input validated, sanitized, or escaped? - [ ] Are secrets, tokens, or PATs handled safely — not logged, not interpolated into shell scripts? - [ ] Are new or modified files present under `testing/` in a non-test-automation PR? - [ ] Is dead code, unused imports, or obvious duplication introduced? - [ ] Are error paths handled, or are failures silently swallowed? - [ ] Are new dependencies justified and compatible with the existing stack? - [ ] Beyond blockers: what other maintainability, correctness, or quality improvements are visible in the changed code? ## 3. Changed-file deep read Do not review from the diff alone. Read the full content of every changed file: - imports and dependencies - class/method responsibilities and adherence to SRP / OOP principles - naming consistency with the rest of the codebase - error handling, logging, and edge cases - test coverage for changed behavior - backward-compatibility and migration impact ## 4. Impact analysis (CodeGraph or grep fallback) Use CodeGraph to find "what could break": - `codegraph_callers` / `codegraph_callees` on modified public symbols - `codegraph_search` for: `PAT_TOKEN`, `secrets.`, `github.token`, `previousViewModel` - `codegraph_impact` before flagging architectural changes **If CodeGraph unavailable**, use grep and document it: ```bash grep -rn "changedFunctionName" --include="*.ts" . grep -rn "secrets\.\|github\.token" . ``` ## 5. Review dimensions Rate the PR across all relevant dimensions: | Dimension | What to check | |---|---| | **Security** | injection, unsafe interpolation, secret leakage, missing permissions, unsafe defaults | | **Architecture / OOP** | SRP, coupling, abstraction consistency, provider/repository boundaries | | **Code quality** | naming, complexity, error handling, logging, comments | | **Tests** | coverage for new/changed paths, meaningful assertions, no brittle string-only tests | | **Duplication** | copy-paste, duplicated logic across files, duplicated configuration | | **Backward compatibility** | public API changes, migration paths, default behavior | | **Performance** | unnecessary rebuilds, heavy sync operations, missing timeouts | | **Workflow / CI safety** | (when `.github/workflows/` changes) secret declarations, ref pinning, permissions, timeouts | ## 6. Severity classification Classify every finding before writing outputs: - **BLOCKING** — merge would cause a bug, security issue, data loss, or CI break. Must be fixed. - **IMPORTANT** — real maintainability or correctness issue. Strongly prefer fixing before merge. - **SUGGESTION** — optional improvement, style, or future polish. Does not block merge. When in doubt, start one level higher; downgrade only after confirming the risk is negligible. ## 7. Exhaustive single-pass review Treat **every** review as the final and only review pass. ## PR Description

Closes #1684
## gh-1684 — Pages deploy blocked: fa-extension.zip size budget +230% after #1631

### Root Cause
- #1631's vendored on-device engines (litert/transformers/webllm) are intentional (gh-1630 CWS no-remote-code policy), but the size floor was never reseeded and the only gate was deploy-time in `pages.yml` — the regression surfaced after merge and blocked Pages (run 39116173117: `TOTAL-1P +230.3%`, 6 lines beyond +5.0%).

### Fix
- **Download channel (AC1/AC2)**: `fa-extension.zip` moves to GitHub Releases. `site/index.html` (5 link/text occurrences incl. the FAQ JSON-LD) + `site/llms.txt` (×2) now point at `releases/latest/download/fa-extension.zip`; the per-release JS rewrite is gone (static href IS the release). `pages.yml` no longer builds/copies/gates the zip; `build-macos.yml` build-extension keeps attaching it to releases (gate-before-upload).
- **Gate at review time (AC3)**: new `extension-size-gate` leg in `ci.yml` — builds the real zip (`--with-app`, Flutter 3.47.7) on extension/app/core/vendor/baseline/workflow-touching PRs + SM validation dispatches, fails the PR against the committed baseline; wired into `quality-gate` (platform class, skipped = pass). A vendor-bump PR without a reseed goes red at review.
- **Reseed (decision 3)**: `scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv` reseeded to the post-#1631 shape (42 rows, TOTAL 155,539,998) from a zip built with the pinned SDK.
- **Never-again (AC4)**: notice-only `web-app.tsv`/`outlook-app.tsv` legs (baselines never committed since #1096) removed from Pages rather than armed.
- **Symmetry (AC5)**: release leg + PR leg + (retired Pages leg) share one baseline, one `size_manifest.py check` invocation, one Flutter 3.47.7 pin — build-macos's old unpinned `channel: stable` pinned.

### macos/PR gate symmetry — why releases looked green (AC5)
The release extension gate was red too (same 6 lines; `fa-extension.zip` absent from v1.0.600 assets). The release *object* still shipped because the tag-cut (`auto_release.sh`) creates it and sibling jobs attach assets without needing the extension job (`release-macos` needs only `[version, build-macos]`; CLI/web-spa legs race-safe `gh release create || true`). Fixed structurally: the PR gate now catches regressions before merge, so the release leg can't be the first alarm.

### Test Coverage
- RED repro: gate vs old baseline fails with the exact ticket signature (+230.3%, 6 lines, 73.3→155.5MB raw). GREEN: reseeded baseline passes (+0.0%); `size_manifest.py selftest` PASS; `scripts/test_size_manifest.py` OK.
- New wiring guard `test/ci_1684_extension_size_gate_test.dart` (17 tests); legacy guards (ci_1267, ci_1659, pub-get-retry, dispatch-watch, site llms/appstore, browser_ext shape) updated + green — 125 tests.

### Notes
- AC4 chose **remove** over arm (owner decision allows either): deploy-time gates are the wrong layer, and a baseline generated from a differently-flagged build would false-red.
- Pages trigger paths dropped `browser_ext/**` (nothing extension-related deploys anymore); website-leg watch budget (60m worst-case) only shrinks.
- Full `dart test` suite result is reported by CI; the touched suites above pass locally.

# gh-1684: [BUG] Pages deploy blocked: fa-extension.zip size budget +230% after #1631 vendored engines (litert/transformers/webllm)

## Description

### Bug

Pages deploy is red: the "Build landing + web demo" job fails at **Size manifest + budget gate (#1096 AC1)** — `build/fa-extension.zip` regressed **TOTAL-1P +230.3%** (35.7MB → 117.9MB first-party; raw 73.3MB → 155.5MB).

Root cause: PR #1631 ("vendor all CDN engines locally") added on-device inference vendor bundles to the extension build — the gate's NEW-entry lines name them exactly:

- `vendor/litert/0.12.1/litertlm_wasm_compat_internal.wasm` (18.8MB) + `litertlm_wasm_internal.wasm` (18.9MB)
- `vendor/transformers/4.2.0/ort-wasm-simd-threaded{,.asyncify}.wasm` (12.9MB + 23.6MB)
- `vendor/webllm/0.2.84/webllm.mjs` (6.1MB)

Example failure: run 39116173117, job 117642302659 (Pages on gh-1670). Every Pages run since #1631 merged fails the same way.

### Context (mapped 2026-10-18)

- `fa-extension.zip` is **not** in GH release assets (v1.0.600: CLI bundles + fa-web-spa.zip only) — Pages (fa1.dev/extension/fa-extension.zip) is the ONLY public download channel today, linked from site/index.html (4 places) + site/llms.txt (2 places) as the documented sideload install path. CWS channel is not live yet (#1631 fixed the rejection; vendoring all engines locally was forced by store policy — that's where the +230% comes from, intentional).
- The same zip is size-gated in build-macos.yml against the SAME committed baseline — yet releases v1.0.599/600 went green while Pages is red: the legs diverged (build flags or a skipped gate). Investigate as part of this fix.

### Owner decision (2026-10-18) — direction locked

1. **Move fa-extension.zip to GH Releases** as a release asset; site links switch to `https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/releases/latest/download/fa-extension.zip` (update site/index.html ×4 + site/llms.txt ×2 in the same PR). Pages stops carrying/copying the zip (drop the assemble-step copy + the Pages size-gate leg for the zip).
2. **The size gate moves to PR review time** (quality-gates job in ci.yml): build the extension zip (or a fast manifest-only variant) on PRs that touch extension sources/vendor and fail the PR on budget regression — the problem must surface at review, not at deployment.
3. Reseed `scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv` to the post-#1631 shape in the same PR (the vendored engines are intentional — CWS policy).
4. Make the build-macos.yml and (new) PR gates symmetric — one baseline, one enforcement rule; resolve why the release leg was green while Pages was red.
5. Never-again: arm or remove the notice-only web-app.tsv/outlook-app.tsv gates (their baselines were never committed — they have been notice-only since #1096).

### Acceptance criteria

1. Pages deploys green; the Pages artifact no longer contains fa-extension.zip; the site's extension download links point at the GH release asset.
2. fa-extension.zip is attached to releases (latest tag onward).
3. The extension size gate runs in PR CI (quality-gates) against the reseeded baseline; a vendor-bump PR without a reseed fails red at review time.
4. web-app.tsv + outlook-app.tsv baselines committed and armed, or the legs removed.
5. The macos/PR gate symmetry question answered in the PR description.

### Evidence

- Failing job log: run 39116173117 / job 117642302659, step "Size manifest + budget gate (#1096 AC1)", `##[error]size budget regression in build/fa-extension.zip (6 line(s) beyond +5.0%)`.
- Introducing change: #1631 (merged).

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary

  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.

- **Updated**: 2026-10-18T16:29:16Z

## PR Description

Closes #1684
## gh-1684 — Pages deploy blocked: fa-extension.zip size budget +230% after #1631

### Root Cause
- #1631's vendored on-device engines (litert/transformers/webllm) are intentional (gh-1630 CWS no-remote-code policy), but the size floor was never reseeded and the only gate was deploy-time in `pages.yml` — the regression surfaced after merge and blocked Pages (run 39116173117: `TOTAL-1P +230.3%`, 6 lines beyond +5.0%).

### Fix
- **Download channel (AC1/AC2)**: `fa-extension.zip` moves to GitHub Releases. `site/index.html` (5 link/text occurrences incl. the FAQ JSON-LD) + `site/llms.txt` (×2) now point at `releases/latest/download/fa-extension.zip`; the per-release JS rewrite is gone (static href IS the release). `pages.yml` no longer builds/copies/gates the zip; `build-macos.yml` build-extension keeps attaching it to releases (gate-before-upload).
- **Gate at review time (AC3)**: new `extension-size-gate` leg in `ci.yml` — builds the real zip (`--with-app`, Flutter 3.47.7) on extension/app/core/vendor/baseline/workflow-touching PRs + SM validation dispatches, fails the PR against the committed baseline; wired into `quality-gate` (platform class, skipped = pass). A vendor-bump PR without a reseed goes red at review.
- **Reseed (decision 3)**: `scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv` reseeded to the post-#1631 shape (42 rows, TOTAL 155,539,998) from a zip built with the pinned SDK.
- **Never-again (AC4)**: notice-only `web-app.tsv`/`outlook-app.tsv` legs (baselines never committed since #1096) removed from Pages rather than armed.
- **Symmetry (AC5)**: release leg + PR leg + (retired Pages leg) share one baseline, one `size_manifest.py check` invocation, one Flutter 3.47.7 pin — build-macos's old unpinned `channel: stable` pinned.

### macos/PR gate symmetry — why releases looked green (AC5)
The release extension gate was red too (same 6 lines; `fa-extension.zip` absent from v1.0.600 assets). The release *object* still shipped because the tag-cut (`auto_release.sh`) creates it and sibling jobs attach assets without needing the extension job (`release-macos` needs only `[version, build-macos]`; CLI/web-spa legs race-safe `gh release create || true`). Fixed structurally: the PR gate now catches regressions before merge, so the release leg can't be the first alarm.

### Test Coverage
- RED repro: gate vs old baseline fails with the exact ticket signature (+230.3%, 6 lines, 73.3→155.5MB raw). GREEN: reseeded baseline passes (+0.0%); `size_manifest.py selftest` PASS; `scripts/test_size_manifest.py` OK.
- New wiring guard `test/ci_1684_extension_size_gate_test.dart` (17 tests); legacy guards (ci_1267, ci_1659, pub-get-retry, dispatch-watch, site llms/appstore, browser_ext shape) updated + green — 125 tests.

### Notes
- AC4 chose **remove** over arm (owner decision allows either): deploy-time gates are the wrong layer, and a baseline generated from a differently-flagged build would false-red.
- Pages trigger paths dropped `browser_ext/**` (nothing extension-related deploys anymore); website-leg watch budget (60m worst-case) only shrinks.
- Full `dart test` suite result is reported by CI; the touched suites above pass locally.

# gh-1684: [BUG] Pages deploy blocked: fa-extension.zip size budget +230% after #1631 vendored engines (litert/transformers/webllm)

## Description

### Bug

Pages deploy is red: the "Build landing + web demo" job fails at **Size manifest + budget gate (#1096 AC1)** — `build/fa-extension.zip` regressed **TOTAL-1P +230.3%** (35.7MB → 117.9MB first-party; raw 73.3MB → 155.5MB).

Root cause: PR #1631 ("vendor all CDN engines locally") added on-device inference vendor bundles to the extension build — the gate's NEW-entry lines name them exactly:

- `vendor/litert/0.12.1/litertlm_wasm_compat_internal.wasm` (18.8MB) + `litertlm_wasm_internal.wasm` (18.9MB)
- `vendor/transformers/4.2.0/ort-wasm-simd-threaded{,.asyncify}.wasm` (12.9MB + 23.6MB)
- `vendor/webllm/0.2.84/webllm.mjs` (6.1MB)

Example failure: run 39116173117, job 117642302659 (Pages on gh-1670). Every Pages run since #1631 merged fails the same way.

### Context (mapped 2026-10-18)

- `fa-extension.zip` is **not** in GH release assets (v1.0.600: CLI bundles + fa-web-spa.zip only) — Pages (fa1.dev/extension/fa-extension.zip) is the ONLY public download channel today, linked from site/index.html (4 places) + site/llms.txt (2 places) as the documented sideload install path. CWS channel is not live yet (#1631 fixed the rejection; vendoring all engines locally was forced by store policy — that's where the +230% comes from, intentional).
- The same zip is size-gated in build-macos.yml against the SAME committed baseline — yet releases v1.0.599/600 went green while Pages is red: the legs diverged (build flags or a skipped gate). Investigate as part of this fix.

### Owner decision (2026-10-18) — direction locked

1. **Move fa-extension.zip to GH Releases** as a release asset; site links switch to `https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/releases/latest/download/fa-extension.zip` (update site/index.html ×4 + site/llms.txt ×2 in the same PR). Pages stops carrying/copying the zip (drop the assemble-step copy + the Pages size-gate leg for the zip).
2. **The size gate moves to PR review time** (quality-gates job in ci.yml): build the extension zip (or a fast manifest-only variant) on PRs that touch extension sources/vendor and fail the PR on budget regression — the problem must surface at review, not at deployment.
3. Reseed `scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv` to the post-#1631 shape in the same PR (the vendored engines are intentional — CWS policy).
4. Make the build-macos.yml and (new) PR gates symmetric — one baseline, one enforcement rule; resolve why the release leg was green while Pages was red.
5. Never-again: arm or remove the notice-only web-app.tsv/outlook-app.tsv gates (their baselines were never committed — they have been notice-only since #1096).

### Acceptance criteria

1. Pages deploys green; the Pages artifact no longer contains fa-extension.zip; the site's extension download links point at the GH release asset.
2. fa-extension.zip is attached to releases (latest tag onward).
3. The extension size gate runs in PR CI (quality-gates) against the reseeded baseline; a vendor-bump PR without a reseed fails red at review time.
4. web-app.tsv + outlook-app.tsv baselines committed and armed, or the legs removed.
5. The macos/PR gate symmetry question answered in the PR description.

### Evidence

- Failing job log: run 39116173117 / job 117642302659, step "Size manifest + budget gate (#1096 AC1)", `##[error]size budget regression in build/fa-extension.zip (6 line(s) beyond +5.0%)`.
- Introducing change: #1631 (merged).

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the

# Pull Request Information

- **Title**: gh-1684 [BUG] Pages deploy blocked: fa-extension.zip size budget +230% after #1631 vendored engines (litert/transformers/webllm)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1684` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 13
- **Additions**: +542
- **Deletions**: -125
- **Created**: 2026-10-18T13:11:23Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-18T16:29:16Z

## PR Description

Closes #1684
## gh-1684 — Pages deploy blocked: fa-extension.zip size budget +230% after #1631

### Root Cause
- #1631's vendored on-device engines (litert/transformers/webllm) are intentional (gh-1630 CWS no-remote-code policy), but the size floor was never reseeded and the only gate was deploy-time in `pages.yml` — the regression surfaced after merge and blocked Pages (run 39116173117: `TOTAL-1P +230.3%`, 6 lines beyond +5.0%).

### Fix
- **Download channel (AC1/AC2)**: `fa-extension.zip` moves to GitHub Releases. `site/index.html` (5 link/text occurrences incl. the FAQ JSON-LD) + `site/llms.txt` (×2) now point at `releases/latest/download/fa-extension.zip`; the per-release JS rewrite is gone (static href IS the release). `pages.yml` no longer builds/copies/gates the zip; `build-macos.yml` build-extension keeps attaching it to releases (gate-before-upload).
- **Gate at review time (AC3)**: new `extension-size-gate` leg in `ci.yml` — builds the real zip (`--with-app`, Flutter 3.47.7) on extension/app/core/vendor/baseline/workflow-touching PRs + SM validation dispatches, fails the PR against the committed baseline; wired into `quality-gate` (platform class, skipped = pass). A vendor-bump PR without a reseed goes red at review.

# gh-1684: [BUG] Pages deploy blocked: fa-extension.zip size budget +230% after #1631 vendored engines (litert/transformers/webllm)

## Description

### Bug

Pages deploy is red: the "Build landing + web demo" job fails at **Size manifest + budget gate (#1096 AC1)** — `build/fa-extension.zip` regressed **TOTAL-1P +230.3%** (35.7MB → 117.9MB first-party; raw 73.3MB → 155.5MB).

Root cause: PR #1631 ("vendor all CDN engines locally") added on-device inference vendor bundles to the extension build — the gate's NEW-entry lines name them exactly:

- `vendor/litert/0.12.1/litertlm_wasm_compat_internal.wasm` (18.8MB) + `litertlm_wasm_internal.wasm` (18.9MB)
- `vendor/transformers/4.2.0/ort-wasm-simd-threaded{,.asyncify}.wasm` (12.9MB + 23.6MB)
- `vendor/webllm/0.2.84/webllm.mjs` (6.1MB)

Example failure: run 39116173117, job 117642302659 (Pages on gh-1670). Every Pages run since #1631 merged fails the same way.

### Context (mapped 2026-10-18)

- `fa-extension.zip` is **not** in GH release assets (v1.0.600: CLI bundles + fa-web-spa.zip only) — Pages (fa1.dev/extension/fa-extension.zip) is the ONLY public download channel today, linked from site/index.html (4 places) + site/llms.txt (2 places) as the documented sideload install path. CWS channel is not live yet (#1631 fixed the rejection; vendoring all engines locally was forced by store policy — that's where the +230% comes from, intentional).
- The same zip is size-gated in build-macos.yml against the SAME committed baseline — yet releases v1.0.599/600 went green while Pages is red: the legs diverged (build flags or a skipped gate). Investigate as part of this fix.

### Owner decision (2026-10-18) — direction locked

1. **Move fa-extension.zip to GH Releases** as a release asset; site links switch to `https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/releases/latest/download/fa-extension.zip` (update site/index.html ×4 + site/llms.txt ×2 in the same PR). Pages stops carrying/copying the zip (drop the assemble-step copy + the Pages size-gate leg for the zip).
2. **The size gate moves to PR review time** (quality-gates job in ci.yml): build the extension zip (or a fast manifest-only variant) on PRs that touch extension sources/vendor and fail the PR on budget regression — the problem must surface at review, not at deployment.
3. Reseed `scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv` to the post-#1631 shape in the same PR (the vendored engines are intentional — CWS policy).
4. Make the build-macos.yml and (new) PR gates symmetric — one baseline, one enforcement rule; resolve why the release leg was green while Pages was red.
5. Never-again: arm or remove the notice-only web-app.tsv/outlook-app.tsv gates (their baselines were never committed — they have been notice-only since #1096).

### Acceptance criteria

1. Pages deploys green; the Pages artifact no longer contains fa-extension.zip; the site's extension download links point at the GH release asset.
2. fa-extension.zip is attached to releases (latest tag onward).
3. The extension size gate runs in PR CI (quality-gates) against the reseeded baseline; a vendor-bump PR without a reseed fails red at review time.
4. web-app.tsv + outlook-app.tsv baselines committed and armed, or the legs removed.
5. The macos/PR gate symmetry question answered in the PR description.

### Evidence

- Failing job log: run 39116173117 / job 117642302659, step "Size manifest + budget gate (#1096 AC1)", `##[error]size budget regression in build/fa-extension.zip (6 line(s) beyond +5.0%)`.
- Introducing change: #1631 (merged).

factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the

- **PR #**: 1693
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1693
- **Title**: gh-1684 [BUG] Pages deploy blocked: fa-extension.zip size budget +230% after #1631 vendored engines (litert/transformers/webllm)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1684` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 13
- **Additions**: +542
- **Deletions**: -125
- **Created**: 2026-10-18T13:11:23Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-18T16:29:16Z

## PR Description

Closes #1684
## gh-1684 — Pages deploy blocked: fa-extension.zip size budget +230% after #1631

### Root Cause
- #1631's vendored on-device engines (litert/transformers/webllm) are intentional (gh-1630 CWS no-remote-code policy), but the size floor was never reseeded and the only gate was deploy-time in `pages.yml` — the regression surfaced after merge and blocked Pages (run 39116173117: `TOTAL-1P +230.3%`, 6 lines beyond +5.0%).

### Fix
- **Download channel (AC1/AC2)**: `fa-extension.zip` moves to GitHub Releases. `site/index.html` (5 link/text occurrences incl. the FAQ JSON-LD) + `site/llms.txt` (×2) now point at `releases/latest/download/fa-extension.zip`; the per-release JS rewrite is gone (static href IS the release). `pages.yml` no longer builds/copies/gates the zip; `build-macos.yml` build-extension keeps attaching it to releases (gate-before-upload).
- **Gate at review time (AC3)**: new `extension-size-gate` leg in `ci.yml` — builds the real zip (`--with-app`, Flutter 3.47.7) on extension/app/core/vendor/baseline/workflow-touching PRs + SM validation dispatches, fails the PR against the committed baseline; wired into `quality-gate` (platform class, skipped = pass). A vendor-bump PR without a reseed goes red at review.
- **Reseed (decision 3)**: `scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv` reseeded to the post-#1631 shape (42 rows, TOTAL 155,539,998) from a zip built with the pinned SDK.
- **Never-again (AC4)**: notice-only `web-app.tsv`/`outlook-app.tsv` legs (baselines never committed since #1096) removed from Pages rather than armed.
- **Symmetry (AC5)**: release leg + PR leg + (retired Pages leg) share one baseline, one `size_manifest.py check` invocation, one Flutter 3.47.7 pin — build-macos's old unpinned `channel: stable` pinned.

### macos/PR gate symmetry — why releases looked green (AC5)
The release extension gate was red too (same 6 lines; `fa-extension.zip` absent from v1.0.600 assets). The release *object* still shipped because the tag-cut (`auto_release.sh`) creates it and sibling jobs attach assets without needing the extension job (`release-macos` needs only `[version, build-macos]`; CLI/web-spa legs race-safe `gh release create || true`). Fixed structurally: the PR gate now catches regressions before merge, so the release leg can't be the first alarm.

### Test Coverage
- RED repro: gate vs old baseline fails with the exact ticket signature (+230.3%, 6 lines, 73.3→155.5MB raw). GREEN: reseeded baseline passes (+0.0%); `size_manifest.py selftest` PASS; `scripts/test_size_manifest.py` OK.
- New wiring guard `test/ci_1684_extension_size_gate_test.dart` (17 tests); legacy guards (ci_1267, ci_1659, pub-get-retry, dispatch-watch, site llms/appstore, browser_ext shape) updated + green — 125 tests.

### Notes
- AC4 chose **remove** over arm (owner decision allows either): deploy-time gates are the wrong layer, and a baseline generated from a differently-flagged build would false-red.
- Pages trigger paths dropped `browser_ext/**` (nothing extension-related deploys anymore); website-leg watch budget (60m worst-case) only shrinks.
- Full `dart test` suite result is reported by CI; the touched suites above pass locally.

# gh-1684: [BUG] Pages deploy blocked: fa-extension.zip size budget +230% after #1631 vendored engines (litert/transformers/webllm)

## Description

### Bug

Pages deploy is red: the "Build landing + web demo" job fails at **Size manifest + budget gate (#1096 AC1)** — `build/fa-extension.zip` regressed **TOTAL-1P +230.3%** (35.7MB → 117.9MB first-party; raw 73.3MB → 155.5MB).

Root cause: PR #1631 ("vendor all CDN engines locally") added on-device inference vendor bundles to the extension build — the gate's NEW-entry lines name them exactly:

- `vendor/litert/0.12.1/litertlm_wasm_compat_internal.wasm` (18.8MB) + `litertlm_wasm_internal.wasm` (18.9MB)
- `vendor/transformers/4.2.0/ort-wasm-simd-threaded{,.asyncify}.wasm` (12.9MB + 23.6MB)
- `vendor/webllm/0.2.84/webllm.mjs` (6.1MB)

Example failure: run 39116173117, job 117642302659 (Pages on gh-1670). Every Pages run since #1631 merged fails the same way.

### Context (mapped 2026-10-18)

- `fa-extension.zip` is **not** in GH release assets (v1.0.600: CLI bundles + fa-web-spa.zip only) — Pages (fa1.dev/extension/fa-extension.zip) is the ONLY public download channel today, linked from site/index.html (4 places) + site/llms.txt (2 places) as the documented sideload install path. CWS channel is not live yet (#1631 fixed the rejection; vendoring all engines locally was forced by store policy — that's where the +230% comes from, intentional).
- The same zip is size-gated in build-macos.yml against the SAME committed baseline — yet releases v1.0.599/600 went green while Pages is red: the legs diverged (build flags or a skipped gate). Investigate as part of this fix.

### Owner decision (2026-10-18) — direction locked

1. **Move fa-extension.zip to GH Releases** as a release asset; site links switch to `https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/releases/latest/download/fa-extension.zip` (update site/index.html ×4 + site/llms.txt ×2 in the same PR). Pages stops carrying/copying the zip (drop the assemble-step copy + the Pages size-gate leg for the zip).
2. **The size gate moves to PR review time** (quality-gates job in ci.yml): build the extension zip (or a fast manifest-only variant) on PRs that touch extension sources/vendor and fail the PR on budget regression — the problem must surface at review, not at deployment.
3. Reseed `scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv` to the post-#1631 shape in the same PR (the vendored engines are intentional — CWS policy).
4. Make the build-macos.yml and (new) PR gates symmetric — one baseline, one enforcement rule; resolve why the release leg was green while Pages was red.
5. Never-again: arm or remove the notice-only web-app.tsv/outlook-app.tsv gates (their baselines were never committed — they have been notice-only since #1096).

### Acceptance criteria

1. Pages deploys green; the Pages artifact no longer contains fa-extension.zip; the site's extension download links point at the GH release asset.
2. fa-extension.zip is attached to releases (latest tag onward).
3. The extension size gate runs in PR CI (quality-gates) against the reseeded baseline; a vendor-bump PR without a reseed fails red at review time.
4. web-app.tsv + outlook-app.tsv baselines committed and armed, or the legs removed.
5. The macos/PR gate symmetry question answered in the PR description.

### Evidence

- Failing job log: run 39116173117 / job 117642302659, step "Size manifest + budget gate (#1096 AC1)", `##[error]size budget regression in build/fa-extension.zip (6 line(s) beyond +5.0%)`.
- Introducing change: #1631 (merged).

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the

Senior Code Reviewer & Security Expert You are an agent triggered to perform a specific task. All required context — ticket description, PR diff, CI status, and related materials — has already been prepared in the `input/` folder. Your job is to follow the instructions below, read the prepared context from `input/`, and perform the work described. Do not ask for identifiers; the context is already available locally. ```mermaid flowchart TD G1["⚠️ Review Guidelines — evaluate against existing codebase patterns"] G2["Before reviewing, explore the project's code structure, architecture, and testing patterns"] G3["If AGENTS.md exists → READ it — defines coding styles to check against"] G4["Flag deviations from established patterns unless justified in PR description"] G1 --> G2 --> G3 --> G4 ``` # PR Review General Guidelines ## Review flow ```mermaid flowchart TD START([PR ready for review]) --> READ["1. Read input context:
instruction.md, ticket.md, pr_info.md,
pr_diff.txt, pr_files.txt, ci_failures.md,
ci_failures_full.log, pr_discussions.md,
pr_discussions_raw.json"] READ --> DIFF["2. Run diff checklist on pr_diff.txt"] DIFF --> FILES["3. Read full content of every changed file"] FILES --> CODEGRAPH["4. Use CodeGraph:
callers/callees of changed symbols,
search for sensitive patterns,
impact analysis"] CODEGRAPH --> DIMS["5. Evaluate review dimensions:
Security · Architecture/OOP · Code quality
Test coverage · Duplication · Backward compatibility"] DIMS --> SEVERITY["6. Classify each finding:
BLOCKING / IMPORTANT / SUGGESTION"] SEVERITY --> EXHAUST["7. Exhaustive pass:
re-read changed files,
surface ALL remaining issues"] EXHAUST --> OUTPUT["8. Write outputs:
pr_review.json · pr_review_general.md · pr_review_comments/*.md"] OUTPUT --> END([End]) ``` ## 1. Input context — MANDATORY reading order ```mermaid flowchart TD subgraph PR_CONTEXT["⚠️ PR-specific files (read first)"] P1["1️⃣ instruction.md (repo root) — project stack, conventions"] P2["2️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_info.md — PR title, author, branch, description"] P3["3️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_diff.txt — the diff to review"] P4["4️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_files.txt — list of changed files"] P5["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures.md — CI failures = BLOCKING (last 500 lines)"] P5_FULL["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures_full.log — full CI logs"] P6["6️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_discussions.md + pr_discussions_raw.json — existing comments"] P1 --> P2 --> P3 --> P4 --> P5 --> P5_FULL --> P6 end subgraph TICKET_CONTEXT["Ticket context (for understanding PR purpose)"] T1["7️⃣ input/TICKET/ticket.md — linked ticket description, ACs"] T2["8️⃣ input/TICKET/comments.md — ticket discussion if present"] T3["9️⃣ input/TICKET/parent-*.md — parent story context"] T4["🔟 input/TICKET/confluence/*.md — linked specifications"] T1 --> T2 --> T3 --> T4 end subgraph RULE["⚠️ Rule"] R1["If file exists in input/ → read locally, do NOT re-fetch via dmtools"] end PR_CONTEXT --> TICKET_CONTEXT --> RULE ``` Read PR files to understand WHAT changed. Read ticket files to understand WHY it changed and verify against requirements. ## 2. Diff checklist — apply to `pr_diff.txt` For every hunk, ask at least these questions: - [ ] Does the change match the ticket scope? Any scope creep? - [ ] Are new or changed public APIs contract-safe for existing callers? - [ ] Is user/external input validated, sanitized, or escaped? - [ ] Are secrets, tokens, or PATs handled safely — not logged, not interpolated into shell scripts? - [ ] Are new or modified files present under `testing/` in a non-test-automation PR? - [ ] Is dead code, unused imports, or obvious duplication introduced? - [ ] Are error paths handled, or are failures silently swallowed? - [ ] Are new dependencies justified and compatible with the existing stack? - [ ] Beyond blockers: what other maintainability, correctness, or quality improvements are visible in the changed code? ## 3. Changed-file deep read Do not review from the diff alone. Read the full content of every changed file: - imports and dependencies - class/method responsibilities and adherence to SRP / OOP principles - naming consistency with the rest of the codebase - error handling, logging, and edge cases - test coverage for changed behavior - backward-compatibility and migration impact ## 4. Impact analysis (CodeGraph or grep fallback) Use CodeGraph to find "what could break": - `codegraph_callers` / `codegraph_callees` on modified public symbols - `codegraph_search` for: `PAT_TOKEN`, `secrets.`, `github.token`, `previousViewModel` - `codegraph_impact` before flagging architectural changes **If CodeGraph unavailable**, use grep and document it: ```bash grep -rn "changedFunctionName" --include="*.ts" . grep -rn "secrets\.\|github\.token" . ``` ## 5. Review dimensions Rate the PR across all relevant dimensions: | Dimension | What to check | |---|---| | **Security** | injection, unsafe interpolation, secret leakage, missing permissions, unsafe defaults | | **Architecture / OOP** | SRP, coupling, abstraction consistency, provider/repository boundaries | | **Code quality** | naming, complexity, error handling, logging, comments | | **Tests** | coverage for new/changed paths, meaningful assertions, no brittle string-only tests | | **Duplication** | copy-paste, duplicated logic across files, duplicated configuration | | **Backward compatibility** | public API changes, migration paths, default behavior | | **Performance** | unnecessary rebuilds, heavy sync operations, missing timeouts | | **Workflow / CI safety** | (when `.github/workflows/` changes) secret declarations, ref pinning, permissions, timeouts | ## 6. Severity classification Classify every finding before writing outputs: - **BLOCKING** — merge would cause a bug, security issue, data loss, or CI break. Must be fixed. - **IMPORTANT** — real maintainability or correctness issue. Strongly prefer fixing before merge. - **SUGGESTION** — optional improvement, style, or future polish. Does not block merge. When in doubt, start one level higher; downgrade only after confirming the risk is negligible. ## 7. Exhaustive single-pass review Treat **every** review as the final and only review pass. The author will not get another chance to catch missed findings cheaply. - Do not defer SUGGESTION or IMPORTANT items to a later round because a BLOCKING issue exists. - After classifying all findings, re-read every changed file and ask: *"What else is improvable here?"* - Before writing outputs, verify that no obvious quality, maintainability, or correctness issue was left unreported. - Aim to surface the maximum number of actionable findings in this single iteration. ## 8. All required context — ticket description, PR diff, CI status, and related materials — has already been prepared in the `input/` folder. Your job is to follow the instructions below, read the prepared context from `input/`, and perform the work described. Do not ask for identifiers; the context is already available locally. ```mermaid flowchart TD G1["⚠️ Review Guidelines — evaluate against existing codebase patterns"] G2["Before reviewing, explore the project's code structure, architecture, and testing patterns"] G3["If AGENTS.md exists → READ it — defines coding styles to check against"] G4["Flag deviations from established patterns unless justified in PR description"] G1 --> G2 --> G3 --> G4 ``` # PR Review General Guidelines ## Review flow ```mermaid flowchart TD START([PR ready for review]) --> READ["1. Read input context:
instruction.md, ticket.md, pr_info.md,
pr_diff.txt, pr_files.txt, ci_failures.md,
ci_failures_full.log, pr_discussions.md,
pr_discussions_raw.json"] READ --> DIFF["2. Run diff checklist on pr_diff.txt"] DIFF --> FILES["3. Read full content of every changed file"] FILES --> CODEGRAPH["4. Use CodeGraph:
callers/callees of changed symbols,
search for sensitive patterns,
impact analysis"] CODEGRAPH --> DIMS["5. Evaluate review dimensions:
Security · Architecture/OOP · Code quality
Test coverage · Duplication · Backward compatibility"] DIMS --> SEVERITY["6. Classify each finding:
BLOCKING / IMPORTANT / SUGGESTION"] SEVERITY --> EXHAUST["7. Exhaustive pass:
re-read changed files,
surface ALL remaining issues"] EXHAUST --> OUTPUT["8. Write outputs:
pr_review.json · pr_review_general.md · pr_review_comments/*.md"] OUTPUT --> END([End]) ``` ## 1. Input context — MANDATORY reading order ```mermaid flowchart TD subgraph PR_CONTEXT["⚠️ PR-specific files (read first)"] P1["1️⃣ instruction.md (repo root) — project stack, conventions"] P2["2️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_info.md — PR title, author, branch, description"] P3["3️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_diff.txt — the diff to review"] P4["4️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_files.txt — list of changed files"] P5["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures.md — CI failures = BLOCKING (last 500 lines)"] P5_FULL["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures_full.log — full CI logs"] P6["6️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_discussions.md + pr_discussions_raw.json — existing comments"] P1 --> P2 --> P3 --> P4 --> P5 --> P5_FULL --> P6 end subgraph TICKET_CONTEXT["Ticket context (for understanding PR purpose)"] T1["7️⃣ input/TICKET/ticket.md — linked ticket description, ACs"] T2["8️⃣ input/TICKET/comments.md — ticket discussion if present"] T3["9️⃣ input/TICKET/parent-*.md — parent story context"] T4["🔟 input/TICKET/confluence/*.md — linked specifications"] T1 --> T2 --> T3 --> T4 end subgraph RULE["⚠️ Rule"] R1["If file exists in input/ → read locally, do NOT re-fetch via dmtools"] end PR_CONTEXT --> TICKET_CONTEXT --> RULE ``` Read PR files to understand WHAT changed. Read ticket files to understand WHY it changed and verify against requirements. ## 2. Diff checklist — apply to `pr_diff.txt` For every hunk, ask at least these questions: - [ ] Does the change match the ticket scope? Any scope creep? - [ ] Are new or changed public APIs contract-safe for existing callers? - [ ] Is user/external input validated, sanitized, or escaped? - [ ] Are secrets, tokens, or PATs handled safely — not logged, not interpolated into shell scripts? - [ ] Are new or modified files present under `testing/` in a non-test-automation PR? - [ ] Is dead code, unused imports, or obvious duplication introduced? - [ ] Are error paths handled, or are failures silently swallowed? - [ ] Are new dependencies justified and compatible with the existing stack? - [ ] Beyond blockers: what other maintainability, correctness, or quality improvements are visible in the changed code? ## 3. Changed-file deep read Do not review from the diff alone. Read the full content of every changed file: - imports and dependencies - class/method responsibilities and adherence to SRP / OOP principles - naming consistency with the rest of the codebase - error handling, logging, and edge cases - test coverage for changed behavior - backward-compatibility and migration impact ## 4. Impact analysis (CodeGraph or grep fallback) Use CodeGraph to find "what could break": - `codegraph_callers` / `codegraph_callees` on modified public symbols - `codegraph_search` for: `PAT_TOKEN`, `secrets.`, `github.token`, `previousViewModel` - `codegraph_impact` before flagging architectural changes **If CodeGraph unavailable**, use grep and document it: ```bash grep -rn "changedFunctionName" --include="*.ts" . grep -rn "secrets\.\|github\.token" . ``` ## 5. Review dimensions Rate the PR across all relevant dimensions: | Dimension | What to check | |---|---| | **Security** | injection, unsafe interpolation, secret leakage, missing permissions, unsafe defaults | | **Architecture / OOP** | SRP, coupling, abstraction consistency, provider/repository boundaries | | **Code quality** | naming, complexity, error handling, logging, comments | | **Tests** | coverage for new/changed paths, meaningful assertions, no brittle string-only tests | | **Duplication** | copy-paste, duplicated logic across files, duplicated configuration | | **Backward compatibility** | public API changes, migration paths, default behavior | | **Performance** | unnecessary rebuilds, heavy sync operations, missing timeouts | | **Workflow / CI safety** | (when `.github/workflows/` changes) secret declarations, ref pinning, permissions, timeouts | ## 6. Severity classification Classify every finding before writing outputs: - **BLOCKING** — merge would cause a bug, security issue, data loss, or CI break. Must be fixed. - **IMPORTANT** — real maintainability or correctness issue. Strongly prefer fixing before merge. - **SUGGESTION** — optional improvement, style, or future polish. Does not block merge. When in doubt, start one level higher; downgrade only after confirming the risk is negligible. ## 7. Exhaustive single-pass review Treat **every** review as the final and only review pass. The author will not get another chance to catch missed findings cheaply. - Do not defer SUGGESTION or IMPORTANT items to a later round because a BLOCKING issue exists. - After classifying all findings, re-read every changed file and ask: *"What else is improvable here?"* - Before writing outputs, verify that no obvious quality, maintainability, or correctness issue was left unreported. - Aim to surface the maximum number of actionable findings in this single iteration. ## 8. Outputs Write the standard review artifacts: - `outputs/pr_review.json` — structured data with `recommendation`, `summary`, `inlineComments`, `issueCounts` - `outputs/pr_review_general.md` — 1-2 paragraph general PR comment - `outputs/pr_review_comments/*.md` — one file per detailed inline comment **Inline comment lines must be present in the PR diff.** GitHub review threads can only be attached to added or context lines inside a diff hunk. If `pr_diff.txt` is truncated, run `git diff origin/{baseBranch}...HEAD` to locate the correct line numbers. Findings on unchanged code outside the diff belong in `outputs/pr_review_general.md`, not as inline comments. Do NOT write `outputs/response.md`; the review is posted to GitHub only. ```mermaid flowchart TD O1["Write outputs/pr_review.json — structured data for GitHub PR re…

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1693
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1693
- **Title**: gh-1684 [BUG] Pages deploy blocked: fa-extension.zip size budget +230% after #1631 vendored engines (litert/transformers/webllm)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1684` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 13
- **Additions**: +542
- **Deletions**: -125
- **Created**: 2026-10-18T13:11:23Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-18T16:29:16Z

## PR Description

Closes #1684
## gh-1684 — Pages deploy blocked: fa-extension.zip size budget +230% after #1631

### Root Cause
- #1631's vendored on-device engines (litert/transformers/webllm) are intentional (gh-1630 CWS no-remote-code policy), but the size floor was never reseeded and the only gate was deploy-time in `pages.yml` — the regression surfaced after merge and blocked Pages (run 39116173117: `TOTAL-1P +230.3%`, 6 lines beyond +5.0%).

### Fix
- **Download channel (AC1/AC2)**: `fa-extension.zip` moves to GitHub Releases. `site/index.html` (5 link/text occurrences incl. the FAQ JSON-LD) + `site/llms.txt` (×2) now point at `releases/latest/download/fa-extension.zip`; the per-release JS rewrite is gone (static href IS the release). `pages.yml` no longer builds/copies/gates the zip; `build-macos.yml` build-extension keeps attaching it to releases (gate-before-upload).
- **Gate at review time (AC3)**: new `extension-size-gate` leg in `ci.yml` — builds the real zip (`--with-app`, Flutter 3.47.7) on extension/app/core/vendor/baseline/workflow-touching PRs + SM validation dispatches, fails the PR against the committed baseline; wired into `quality-gate` (platform class, skipped = pass). A vendor-bump PR without a reseed goes red at review.
- **Reseed (decision 3)**: `scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv` reseeded to the post-#1631 shape (42 rows, TOTAL 155,539,998) from a zip built with the pinned SDK.
- **Never-again (AC4)**: notice-only `web-app.tsv`/`outlook-app.tsv` legs (baselines never committed since #1096) removed from Pages rather than armed.
- **Symmetry (AC5)**: release leg + PR leg + (retired Pages leg) share one baseline, one `size_manifest.py check` invocation, one Flutter 3.47.7 pin — build-macos's old unpinned `channel: stable` pinned.

### macos/PR gate symmetry — why releases looked green (AC5)
The release extension gate was red too (same 6 lines; `fa-extension.zip` absent from v1.0.600 assets). The release *object* still shipped because the tag-cut (`auto_release.sh`) creates it and sibling jobs attach assets without needing the extension job (`release-macos` needs only `[version, build-macos]`; CLI/web-spa legs race-safe `gh release create || true`). Fixed structurally: the PR gate now catches regressions before merge, so the release leg can't be the first alarm.

### Test Coverage
- RED repro: gate vs old baseline fails with the exact ticket signature (+230.3%, 6 lines, 73.3→155.5MB raw). GREEN: reseeded baseline passes (+0.0%); `size_manifest.py selftest` PASS; `scripts/test_size_manifest.py` OK.
- New wiring guard `test/ci_1684_extension_size_gate_test.dart` (17 tests); legacy guards (ci_1267, ci_1659, pub-get-retry, dispatch-watch, site llms/appstore, browser_ext shape) updated + green — 125 tests.

### Notes
- AC4 chose **remove** over arm (owner decision allows either): deploy-time gates are the wrong layer, and a baseline generated from a differently-flagged build would false-red.
- Pages trigger paths dropped `browser_ext/**` (nothing extension-related deploys anymore); website-leg watch budget (60m worst-case) only shrinks.
- Full `dart test` suite result is reported by CI; the touched suites above pass locally.

# gh-1684: [BUG] Pages deploy blocked: fa-extension.zip size budget +230% after #1631 vendored engines (litert/transformers/webllm)

## Description

### Bug

Pages deploy is red: the "Build landing + web demo" job fails at **Size manifest + budget gate (#1096 AC1)** — `build/fa-extension.zip` regressed **TOTAL-1P +230.3%** (35.7MB → 117.9MB first-party; raw 73.3MB → 155.5MB).

Root cause: PR #1631 ("vendor all CDN engines locally") added on-device inference vendor bundles to the extension build — the gate's NEW-entry lines name them exactly:

- `vendor/litert/0.12.1/litertlm_wasm_compat_internal.wasm` (18.8MB) + `litertlm_wasm_internal.wasm` (18.9MB)
- `vendor/transformers/4.2.0/ort-wasm-simd-threaded{,.asyncify}.wasm` (12.9MB + 23.6MB)
- `vendor/webllm/0.2.84/webllm.mjs` (6.1MB)

Example failure: run 39116173117, job 117642302659 (Pages on gh-1670). Every Pages run since #1631 merged fails the same way.

### Context (mapped 2026-10-18)

- `fa-extension.zip` is **not** in GH release assets (v1.0.600: CLI bundles + fa-web-spa.zip only) — Pages (fa1.dev/extension/fa-extension.zip) is the ONLY public download channel today, linked from site/index.html (4 places) + site/llms.txt (2 places) as the documented sideload install path. CWS channel is not live yet (#1631 fixed the rejection; vendoring all engines locally was forced by store policy — that's where the +230% comes from, intentional).
- The same zip is size-gated in build-macos.yml against the SAME committed baseline — yet releases v1.0.599/600 went green while Pages is red: the legs diverged (build flags or a skipped gate). Investigate as part of this fix.

### Owner decision (2026-10-18) — direction locked

1. **Move fa-extension.zip to GH Releases** as a release asset; site links switch to `https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/releases/latest/download/fa-extension.zip` (update site/index.html ×4 + site/llms.txt ×2 in the same PR). Pages stops carrying/copying the zip (drop the assemble-step copy + the Pages size-gate leg for the zip).
2. **The size gate moves to PR review time** (quality-gates job in ci.yml): build the extension zip (or a fast manifest-only variant) on PRs that touch extension sources/vendor and fail the PR on budget regression — the problem must surface at review, not at deployment.
3. Reseed `scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv` to the post-#1631 shape in the same PR (the vendored engines are intentional — CWS policy).
4. Make the build-macos.yml and (new) PR gates symmetric — one baseline, one enforcement rule; resolve why the release leg was green while Pages was red.
5. Never-again: arm or remove the notice-only web-app.tsv/outlook-app.tsv gates (their baselines were never committed — they have been notice-only since #1096).

### Acceptance criteria

1. Pages deploys green; the Pages artifact no longer contains fa-extension.zip; the site's extension download links point at the GH release asset.
2. fa-extension.zip is attached to releases (latest tag onward).
3. The extension size gate runs in PR CI (quality-gates) against the reseeded baseline; a vendor-bump PR without a reseed fails red at review time.
4. web-app.tsv + outlook-app.tsv baselines committed and armed, or the legs removed.
5. The macos/PR gate symmetry question answered in the PR description.

### Evidence

- Failing job log: run 39116173117 / job 117642302659, step "Size manifest + budget gate (#1096 AC1)", `##[error]size budget regression in build/fa-extension.zip (6 line(s) beyond +5.0%)`.
- Introducing change: #1631 (merged).

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary

  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
