build-extension:
    name: Build Chrome extension
    needs: version
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Ceiling for the daily cli watcher's budget arithmetic (#351).
    timeout-minutes: 30
    if: inputs.create_release == 'true'
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          # gh-1684 decision 4 (gate symmetry): the SAME exact patch pin
          # the pages.yml leg carried and the PR gate carries (#1431 —
          # the rev normalization absorbs canvaskit rev-hash churn, the
          # pin keeps every fa-extension.zip build comparable across
          # legs). The old unpinned `channel: stable` floated the engine
          # per run — one of the two ways the release and Pages legs
          # diverged.
          flutter-version: '3.47.7'
          channel: stable

      - name: dart pub get (root)
        run: dart pub get

      # browser_ext/dart is a separate package (path dep on this root), so
      # its pub get must follow the root's — same as browser-ext.yml.
      - name: dart pub get (browser_ext/dart)
        run: cd browser_ext/dart && dart pub get

      # Full artifact: SW agent (dart2js) + the Flutter panel app embedded,
      # exactly what "Load unpacked" expects. --clobber keeps the stable
      # asset name fa-extension.zip pointing at the newest build (the
      # landing page links it directly).
      - name: Build extension zip
        run: bash scripts/build_browser_ext.sh --with-app

      # AC1 (#1096): per-entry uncompressed size table + +5% budget gate
      # against the committed baseline (gh-1684: reseeded to the
      # post-#1631 vendored-engines shape — litert/transformers/webllm are
      # intentional CWS policy; growth beyond the floor fails the release).
      # Identical invocation as the PR-time gate (ci.yml
      # extension-size-gate): one baseline, one enforcement rule.
      - name: Size manifest + budget gate (fa-extension.zip)
        run: python3 scripts/size_manifest.py check build/fa-extension.zip --baseline scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv

      - name: Upload extension to the release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_PAT }}
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ needs.version.outputs.tag }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          asset="fa-extension.zip"
          cp build/fa-extension.zip "$asset"
          ls -lh "$asset"

          # Ensure the release exists (race-safe with release-macos). Title
          # is the bare tag vX.Y.Z (issue #282), latest is explicit.
          if ! gh release view "$RELEASE_TAG" --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            gh release create "$RELEASE_TAG" \
              --title "$RELEASE_TAG" \
              --generate-notes \
              --latest \
              --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" || true
          fi
          gh release upload "$RELEASE_TAG" "$asset" --clobber --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}"

      # Draft lifecycle invariant (issue #282): this job creates releases,
      # so a failed/cancelled run must not leave one behind as a draft.
      - name: Draft lifecycle guard (delete orphaned draft on failure)
        if: always() && job.status != 'success'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_PAT }}
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ needs.version.outputs.tag }}
        run: bash scripts/release_draft_guard.sh "$RELEASE_TAG"

  release-macos:

      - id: filter

        run: |

          echo "app=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "docs=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "shared=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      # PR classification runs through THE SAME classifier the pre-commit
      # hook uses (issue #194, AC7 + AC5/E2): one source of truth for path
      # rules, and the unknown-path safe default (full gate) — e.g. a new
      # dart_test.yaml at the repo root — now holds in CI, not only in the
      # hook. The selected stage set maps back to the same four groups the
      # old dorny filter emitted.
      - id: paths
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
        env:
          BASE_REF: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          HEAD_REF: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: |
          # ── Issue #1267 N1/N2 dispatch arm ──────────────────────────────
          # SM validation dispatches carry NO pull_request event context,
          # so BASE_REF/HEAD_REF are empty there: derive the validated diff
          # from git — merge-base(origin/main, HEAD) is the PR fork point
          # (the checkout above is fetch-depth: 0, so origin/main exists).
          # merge-base == HEAD (a main dispatch, or an already-merged
          # branch) diffs to nothing and the narrowed arms skip. A failed
          # resolve fails SAFE: both arms run unconditioned —
          # over-triggering a rare-path leg costs minutes, under-triggering
          # one hides a nightly-only red (the #1309 class).
          if [ -z "$HEAD_REF" ]; then
            HEAD_REF="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
            BASE_REF="$(git merge-base origin/main "$HEAD_REF" 2>/dev/null || true)"
            if [ -z "$BASE_REF" ]; then
              echo "::warning::merge-base(origin/main, HEAD) failed on the dispatch checkout — failing safe: exzone + locksmoke + installer + office_addin + extsize arms run"
              echo "exzone=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "locksmoke=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "installer=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "office_addin=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "extsize=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              exit 0
            fi
          fi

- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1684` → `main`

- **Updated**: 2026-10-18T16:29:16Z

## PR Description

Closes #1684
## gh-1684 — Pages deploy blocked: fa-extension.zip size budget +230% after #1631

### Root Cause
- #1631's vendored on-device engines (litert/transformers/webllm) are intentional (gh-1630 CWS no-remote-code policy), but the size floor was never reseeded and the only gate was deploy-time in `pages.yml` — the regression surfaced after merge and blocked Pages (run 39116173117: `TOTAL-1P +230.3%`, 6 lines beyond +5.0%).

### Fix
- **Download channel (AC1/AC2)**: `fa-extension.zip` moves to GitHub Releases. `site/index.html` (5 link/text occurrences incl. the FAQ JSON-LD) + `site/llms.txt` (×2) now point at `releases/latest/download/fa-extension.zip`; the per-release JS rewrite is gone (static href IS the release). `pages.yml` no longer builds/copies/gates the zip; `build-macos.yml` build-extension keeps attaching it to releases (gate-before-upload).
- **Gate at review time (AC3)**: new `extension-size-gate` leg in `ci.yml` — builds the real zip (`--with-app`, Flutter 3.47.7) on extension/app/core/vendor/baseline/workflow-touching PRs + SM validation dispatches, fails the PR against the committed baseline; wired into `quality-gate` (platform class, skipped = pass). A vendor-bump PR without a reseed goes red at review.
- **Reseed (decision 3)**: `scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv` reseeded to the post-#1631 shape (42 rows, TOTAL 155,539,998) from a zip built with the pinned SDK.
- **Never-again (AC4)**: notice-only `web-app.tsv`/`outlook-app.tsv` legs (baselines never committed since #1096) removed from Pages rather than armed.
- **Symmetry (AC5)**: release leg + PR leg + (retired Pages leg) share one baseline, one `size_manifest.py check` invocation, one Flutter 3.47.7 pin — build-macos's old unpinned `channel: stable` pinned.

### macos/PR gate symmetry — why releases looked green (AC5)
The release extension gate was red too (same 6 lines; `fa-extension.zip` absent from v1.0.600 assets). The release *object* still shipped because the tag-cut (`auto_release.sh`) creates it and sibling jobs attach assets without needing the extension job (`release-macos` needs only `[version, build-macos]`; CLI/web-spa legs race-safe `gh release create || true`). Fixed structurally: the PR gate now catches regressions before merge, so the release leg can't be the first alarm.

### Test Coverage
- RED repro: gate vs old baseline fails with the exact ticket signature (+230.3%, 6 lines, 73.3→155.5MB raw). GREEN: reseeded baseline passes (+0.0%); `size_manifest.py selftest` PASS; `scripts/test_size_manifest.py` OK.
- New wiring guard `test/ci_1684_extension_size_gate_test.dart` (17 tests); legacy guards (ci_1267, ci_1659, pub-get-retry, dispatch-watch, site llms/appstore, browser_ext shape) updated + green — 125 tests.

### Notes
- AC4 chose **remove** over arm (owner decision allows either): deploy-time gates are the wrong layer, and a baseline generated from a differently-flagged build would false-red.
- Pages trigger paths dropped `browser_ext/**` (nothing extension-related deploys anymore); website-leg watch budget (60m worst-case) only shrinks.
- Full `dart test` suite result is reported by CI; the touched suites above pass locally.

## Description

### Bug

Pages deploy is red: the "Build landing + web demo" job fails at **Size manifest + budget gate (#1096 AC1)** — `build/fa-extension.zip` regressed **TOTAL-1P +230.3%** (35.7MB → 117.9MB first-party; raw 73.3MB → 155.5MB).

Root cause: PR #1631 ("vendor all CDN engines locally") added on-device inference vendor bundles to the extension build — the gate's NEW-entry lines name them exactly:

- `vendor/litert/0.12.1/litertlm_wasm_compat_internal.wasm` (18.8MB) + `litertlm_wasm_internal.wasm` (18.9MB)
- `vendor/transformers/4.2.0/ort-wasm-simd-threaded{,.asyncify}.wasm` (12.9MB + 23.6MB)
- `vendor/webllm/0.2.84/webllm.mjs` (6.1MB)

Example failure: run 39116173117, job 117642302659 (Pages on gh-1670). Every Pages run since #1631 merged fails the same way.

### Context (mapped 2026-10-18)

- `fa-extension.zip` is **not** in GH release assets (v1.0.600: CLI bundles + fa-web-spa.zip only) — Pages (fa1.dev/extension/fa-extension.zip) is the ONLY public download channel today, linked from site/index.html (4 places) + site/llms.txt (2 places) as the documented sideload install path. CWS channel is not live yet (#1631 fixed the rejection; vendoring all engines locally was forced by store policy — that's where the +230% comes from, intentional).
- The same zip is size-gated in build-macos.yml against the SAME committed baseline — yet releases v1.0.599/600 went green while Pages is red: the legs diverged (build flags or a skipped gate). Investigate as part of this fix.

### Owner decision (2026-10-18) — direction locked

1. **Move fa-extension.zip to GH Releases** as a release asset; site links switch to `https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/releases/latest/download/fa-extension.zip` (update site/index.html ×4 + site/llms.txt ×2 in the same PR). Pages stops carrying/copying the zip (drop the assemble-step copy + the Pages size-gate leg for the zip).
2. **The size gate moves to PR review time** (quality-gates job in ci.yml): build the extension zip (or a fast manifest-only variant) on PRs that touch extension sources/vendor and fail the PR on budget regression — the problem must surface at review, not at deployment.
3. Reseed `scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv` to the post-#1631 shape in the same PR (the vendored engines are intentional — CWS policy).
4. Make the build-macos.yml and (new) PR gates symmetric — one baseline, one enforcement rule; resolve why the release leg was green while Pages was red.
5. Never-again: arm or remove the notice-only web-app.tsv/outlook-app.tsv gates (their baselines were never committed — they have been notice-only since #1096).

### Acceptance criteria

1. Pages deploys green; the Pages artifact no longer contains fa-extension.zip; the site's extension download links point at the GH release asset.
2. fa-extension.zip is attached to releases (latest tag onward).
3. The extension size gate runs in PR CI (quality-gates) against the reseeded baseline; a vendor-bump PR without a reseed fails red at review time.
4. web-app.tsv + outlook-app.tsv baselines committed and armed, or the legs removed.
5. The macos/PR gate symmetry question answered in the PR description.

### Evidence

- Failing job log: run 39116173117 / job 117642302659, step "Size manifest + budget gate (#1096 AC1)", `##[error]size budget regression in build/fa-extension.zip (6 line(s) beyond +5.0%)`.

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,

build-extension:
    name: Build Chrome extension
    needs: version
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Ceiling for the daily cli watcher's budget arithmetic (#351).
    timeout-minutes: 30
    if: inputs.create_release == 'true'
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          # gh-1684 decision 4 (gate symmetry): the SAME exact patch pin
          # the pages.yml leg carried and the PR gate carries (#1431 —
          # the rev normalization absorbs canvaskit rev-hash churn, the
          # pin keeps every fa-extension.zip build comparable across
          # legs). The old unpinned `channel: stable` floated the engine
          # per run — one of the two ways the release and Pages legs
          # diverged.
          flutter-version: '3.47.7'
          channel: stable

      - name: dart pub get (root)
        run: dart pub get

      # browser_ext/dart is a separate package (path dep on this root), so
      # its pub get must follow the root's — same as browser-ext.yml.
      - name: dart pub get (browser_ext/dart)
        run: cd browser_ext/dart && dart pub get

        env:

          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ needs.version.outputs.tag }}

          asset="fa-extension.zip"
          cp build/fa-extension.zip "$asset"
          ls -lh "$asset"

          # is the bare tag vX.Y.Z (issue #282), latest is explicit.

              --title "$RELEASE_TAG" \
              --generate-notes \
              --latest \
              --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" || true

          gh release upload "$RELEASE_TAG" "$asset" --clobber --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}"

      # so a failed/cancelled run must not leave one behind as a draft.
      - name: Draft lifecycle guard (delete orphaned draft on failure)
        if: always() && job.status != 'success'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_PAT }}
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ needs.version.outputs.tag }}
        run: bash scripts/release_draft_guard.sh "$RELEASE_TAG"

# (workflow_dispatch on the rebased PR head) is the pre-merge gate
      # and lands in this arm, so every validation runs the whole-tree
      # gates (crap4dart baseline, coverage ratchet, jscpd) — nothing was
      # ever main-only.
      - id: filter
        if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
        run: |
          echo "core=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "app=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "docs=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "shared=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      # PR classification runs through THE SAME classifier the pre-commit
      # hook uses (issue #194, AC7 + AC5/E2): one source of truth for path
      # rules, and the unknown-path safe default (full gate) — e.g. a new
      # dart_test.yaml at the repo root — now holds in CI, not only in the
      # hook. The selected stage set maps back to the same four groups the
      # old dorny filter emitted.
      - id: paths
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
        env:
          BASE_REF: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          HEAD_REF: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: |
          # ── Issue #1267 N1/N2 dispatch arm ──────────────────────────────
          # SM validation dispatches carry NO pull_request event context,
          # so BASE_REF/HEAD_REF are empty there: derive the validated diff
          # from git — merge-base(origin/main, HEAD) is the PR fork point
          # (the checkout above is fetch-depth: 0, so origin/main exists).
          # merge-base == HEAD (a main dispatch, or an already-merged
          # branch) diffs to nothing and the narrowed arms skip. A failed
          # resolve fails SAFE: both arms run unconditioned —
          # over-triggering a rare-path leg costs minutes, under-triggering
          # one hides a nightly-only red (the #1309 class).
          if [ -z "$HEAD_REF" ]; then
            HEAD_REF="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
            BASE_REF="$(git merge-base origin/main "$HEAD_REF" 2>/dev/null || true)"
            if [ -z "$BASE_REF" ]; then
              echo "::warning::merge-base(origin/main, HEAD) failed on the dispatch checkout — failing safe: exzone + locksmoke + installer + office_addin + extsize arms run"
              echo "exzone=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "locksmoke=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "installer=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "office_addin=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "extsize=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              exit 0
            fi
          fi

# gh-1684: [BUG] Pages deploy blocked: fa-extension.zip size budget +230% after #1631 vendored engines (litert/transformers/webllm)

## Description

### Bug

Pages deploy is red: the "Build landing + web demo" job fails at **Size manifest + budget gate (#1096 AC1)** — `build/fa-extension.zip` regressed **TOTAL-1P +230.3%** (35.7MB → 117.9MB first-party; raw 73.3MB → 155.5MB).

Root cause: PR #1631 ("vendor all CDN engines locally") added on-device inference vendor bundles to the extension build — the gate's NEW-entry lines name them exactly:

- `vendor/litert/0.12.1/litertlm_wasm_compat_internal.wasm` (18.8MB) + `litertlm_wasm_internal.wasm` (18.9MB)
- `vendor/transformers/4.2.0/ort-wasm-simd-threaded{,.asyncify}.wasm` (12.9MB + 23.6MB)
- `vendor/webllm/0.2.84/webllm.mjs` (6.1MB)

Example failure: run 39116173117, job 117642302659 (Pages on gh-1670). Every Pages run since #1631 merged fails the same way.

### Context (mapped 2026-10-18)

- `fa-extension.zip` is **not** in GH release assets (v1.0.600: CLI bundles + fa-web-spa.zip only) — Pages (fa1.dev/extension/fa-extension.zip) is the ONLY public download channel today, linked from site/index.html (4 places) + site/llms.txt (2 places) as the documented sideload install path. CWS channel is not live yet (#1631 fixed the rejection; vendoring all engines locally was forced by store policy — that's where the +230% comes from, intentional).
- The same zip is size-gated in build-macos.yml against the SAME committed baseline — yet releases v1.0.599/600 went green while Pages is red: the legs diverged (build flags or a skipped gate). Investigate as part of this fix.

### Owner decision (2026-10-18) — direction locked

1. **Move fa-extension.zip to GH Releases** as a release asset; site links switch to `https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/releases/latest/download/fa-extension.zip` (update site/index.html ×4 + site/llms.txt ×2 in the same PR). Pages stops carrying/copying the zip (drop the assemble-step copy + the Pages size-gate leg for the zip).
2. **The size gate moves to PR review time** (quality-gates job in ci.yml): build the extension zip (or a fast manifest-only variant) on PRs that touch extension sources/vendor and fail the PR on budget regression — the problem must surface at review, not at deployment.
3. Reseed `scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv` to the post-#1631 shape in the same PR (the vendored engines are intentional — CWS policy).
4. Make the build-macos.yml and (new) PR gates symmetric — one baseline, one enforcement rule; resolve why the release leg was green while Pages was red.
5. Never-again: arm or remove the notice-only web-app.tsv/outlook-app.tsv gates (their baselines were never committed — they have been notice-only since #1096).

### Acceptance criteria

1. Pages deploys green; the Pages artifact no longer contains fa-extension.zip; the site's extension download links point at the GH release asset.
2. fa-extension.zip is attached to releases (latest tag onward).
3. The extension size gate runs in PR CI (quality-gates) against the reseeded baseline; a vendor-bump PR without a reseed fails red at review time.
4. web-app.tsv + outlook-app.tsv baselines committed and armed, or the legs removed.
5. The macos/PR gate symmetry question answered in the PR description.

### Evidence

- Failing job log: run 39116173117 / job 117642302659, step "Size manifest + budget gate (#1096 AC1)", `##[error]size budget regression in build/fa-extension.zip (6 line(s) beyond +5.0%)`.
- Introducing change: #1631 (merged).

factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary

build-extension:
    name: Build Chrome extension
    needs: version
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Ceiling for the daily cli watcher's budget arithmetic (#351).
    timeout-minutes: 30
    if: inputs.create_release == 'true'
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          # gh-1684 decision 4 (gate symmetry): the SAME exact patch pin
          # the pages.yml leg carried and the PR gate carries (#1431 —
          # the rev normalization absorbs canvaskit rev-hash churn, the
          # pin keeps every fa-extension.zip build comparable across
          # legs). The old unpinned `channel: stable` floated the engine
          # per run — one of the two ways the release and Pages legs
          # diverged.
          flutter-version: '3.47.7'
          channel: stable

      - name: dart pub get (root)
        run: dart pub get

      # browser_ext/dart is a separate package (path dep on this root), so
      # its pub get must follow the root's — same as browser-ext.yml.
      - name: dart pub get (browser_ext/dart)
        run: cd browser_ext/dart && dart pub get

      # Full artifact: SW agent (dart2js) + the Flutter panel app embedded,
      # exactly what "Load unpacked" expects. --clobber keeps the stable
      # asset name fa-extension.zip pointing at the newest build (the
      # landing page links it directly).
      - name: Build extension zip
        run: bash scripts/build_browser_ext.sh --with-app

      # AC1 (#1096): per-entry uncompressed size table + +5% budget gate
      # against the committed baseline (gh-1684: reseeded to the
      # post-#1631 vendored-engines shape — litert/transformers/webllm are
      # intentional CWS policy; growth beyond the floor fails the release).
      # Identical invocation as the PR-time gate (ci.yml
      # extension-size-gate): one baseline, one enforcement rule.
      - name: Size manifest + budget gate (fa-extension.zip)
        run: python3 scripts/size_manifest.py check build/fa-extension.zip --baseline scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv

      - name: Upload extension to the release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_PAT }}
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ needs.version.outputs.tag }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          asset="fa-extension.zip"
          cp build/fa-extension.zip "$asset"
          ls -lh "$asset"

          # Ensure the release exists (race-safe with release-macos). Title
          # is the bare tag vX.Y.Z (issue #282), latest is explicit.
          if ! gh release view "$RELEASE_TAG" --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            gh release create "$RELEASE_TAG" \
              --title "$RELEASE_TAG" \
              --generate-notes \
              --latest \
              --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" || true
          fi
          gh release upload "$RELEASE_TAG" "$asset" --clobber --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}"

      # Draft lifecycle invariant (issue #282): this job creates releases,
      # so a failed/cancelled run must not leave one behind as a draft.
      - name: Draft lifecycle guard (delete orphaned draft on failure)
        if: always() && job.status != 'success'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_PAT }}
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ needs.version.outputs.tag }}
        run: bash scripts/release_draft_guard.sh "$RELEASE_TAG"

  release-macos:

Does not block merge. When in doubt, start one level higher; downgrade only after confirming the risk is negligible. ## 7. # (workflow_dispatch on the rebased PR head) is the pre-merge gate
      # and lands in this arm, so every validation runs the whole-tree
      # gates (crap4dart baseline, coverage ratchet, jscpd) — nothing was
      # ever main-only.
      - id: filter
        if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
        run: |
          echo "core=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "app=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "docs=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "shared=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      # PR classification runs through THE SAME classifier the pre-commit
      # hook uses (issue #194, AC7 + AC5/E2): one source of truth for path
      # rules, and the unknown-path safe default (full gate) — e.g. a new
      # dart_test.yaml at the repo root — now holds in CI, not only in the
      # hook. The selected stage set maps back to the same four groups the
      # old dorny filter emitted.
      - id: paths
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
        env:
          BASE_REF: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          HEAD_REF: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: |
          # ── Issue #1267 N1/N2 dispatch arm ──────────────────────────────
          # SM validation dispatches carry NO pull_request event context,
          # so BASE_REF/HEAD_REF are empty there: derive the validated diff
          # from git — merge-base(origin/main, HEAD) is the PR fork point
          # (the checkout above is fetch-depth: 0, so origin/main exists).
          # merge-base == HEAD (a main dispatch, or an already-merged
          # branch) diffs to nothing and the narrowed arms skip. A failed
          # resolve fails SAFE: both arms run unconditioned —
          # over-triggering a rare-path leg costs minutes, under-triggering
          # one hides a nightly-only red (the #1309 class).
          if [ -z "$HEAD_REF" ]; then
            HEAD_REF="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
            BASE_REF="$(git merge-base origin/main "$HEAD_REF" 2>/dev/null || true)"
            if [ -z "$BASE_REF" ]; then
              echo "::warning::merge-base(origin/main, HEAD) failed on the dispatch checkout — failing safe: exzone + locksmoke + installer + office_addin + extsize arms run"
              echo "exzone=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "locksmoke=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "installer=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "office_addin=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "extsize=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              exit 0
            fi
          fi

# gh-1684: [BUG] Pages deploy blocked: fa-extension.zip size budget +230% after #1631 vendored engines (litert/transformers/webllm)

## Description

### Bug

Pages deploy is red: the "Build landing + web demo" job fails at **Size manifest + budget gate (#1096 AC1)** — `build/fa-extension.zip` regressed **TOTAL-1P +230.3%** (35.7MB → 117.9MB first-party; raw 73.3MB → 155.5MB).

Root cause: PR #1631 ("vendor all CDN engines locally") added on-device inference vendor bundles to the extension build — the gate's NEW-entry lines name them exactly:

- `vendor/litert/0.12.1/litertlm_wasm_compat_internal.wasm` (18.8MB) + `litertlm_wasm_internal.wasm` (18.9MB)
- `vendor/transformers/4.2.0/ort-wasm-simd-threaded{,.asyncify}.wasm` (12.9MB + 23.6MB)
- `vendor/webllm/0.2.84/webllm.mjs` (6.1MB)

Example failure: run 39116173117, job 117642302659 (Pages on gh-1670). Every Pages run since #1631 merged fails the same way.

### Context (mapped 2026-10-18)

- `fa-extension.zip` is **not** in GH release assets (v1.0.600: CLI bundles + fa-web-spa.zip only) — Pages (fa1.dev/extension/fa-extension.zip) is the ONLY public download channel today, linked from site/index.html (4 places) + site/llms.txt (2 places) as the documented sideload install path. CWS channel is not live yet (#1631 fixed the rejection; vendoring all engines locally was forced by store policy — that's where the +230% comes from, intentional).
- The same zip is size-gated in build-macos.yml against the SAME committed baseline — yet releases v1.0.599/600 went green while Pages is red: the legs diverged (build flags or a skipped gate). Investigate as part of this fix.

### Owner decision (2026-10-18) — direction locked

1. **Move fa-extension.zip to GH Releases** as a release asset; site links switch to `https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/releases/latest/download/fa-extension.zip` (update site/index.html ×4 + site/llms.txt ×2 in the same PR). Pages stops carrying/copying the zip (drop the assemble-step copy + the Pages size-gate leg for the zip).
2. **The size gate moves to PR review time** (quality-gates job in ci.yml): build the extension zip (or a fast manifest-only variant) on PRs that touch extension sources/vendor and fail the PR on budget regression — the problem must surface at review, not at deployment.
3. Reseed `scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv` to the post-#1631 shape in the same PR (the vendored engines are intentional — CWS policy).
4. Make the build-macos.yml and (new) PR gates symmetric — one baseline, one enforcement rule; resolve why the release leg was green while Pages was red.
5. Never-again: arm or remove the notice-only web-app.tsv/outlook-app.tsv gates (their baselines were never committed — they have been notice-only since #1096).

### Acceptance criteria

1. Pages deploys green; the Pages artifact no longer contains fa-extension.zip; the site's extension download links point at the GH release asset.
2. fa-extension.zip is attached to releases (latest tag onward).
3. The extension size gate runs in PR CI (quality-gates) against the reseeded baseline; a vendor-bump PR without a reseed fails red at review time.
4. web-app.tsv + outlook-app.tsv baselines committed and armed, or the legs removed.
5. The macos/PR gate symmetry question answered in the PR description.

### Evidence

- Failing job log: run 39116173117 / job 117642302659, step "Size manifest + budget gate (#1096 AC1)", `##[error]size budget regression in build/fa-extension.zip (6 line(s) beyond +5.0%)`.
- Introducing change: #1631 (merged).

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files

  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the

build-extension:
    name: Build Chrome extension
    needs: version
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Ceiling for the daily cli watcher's budget arithmetic (#351).
    timeout-minutes: 30
    if: inputs.create_release == 'true'
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          # gh-1684 decision 4 (gate symmetry): the SAME exact patch pin
          # the pages.yml leg carried and the PR gate carries (#1431 —
          # the rev normalization absorbs canvaskit rev-hash churn, the
          # pin keeps every fa-extension.zip build comparable across
          # legs). The old unpinned `channel: stable` floated the engine
          # per run — one of the two ways the release and Pages legs
          # diverged.
          flutter-version: '3.47.7'
          channel: stable

      - name: dart pub get (root)
        run: dart pub get

      # browser_ext/dart is a separate package (path dep on this root), so
      # its pub get must follow the root's — same as browser-ext.yml.
      - name: dart pub get (browser_ext/dart)
        run: cd browser_ext/dart && dart pub get

      # Full artifact: SW agent (dart2js) + the Flutter panel app embedded,
      # exactly what "Load unpacked" expects. --clobber keeps the stable
      # asset name fa-extension.zip pointing at the newest build (the
      # landing page links it directly).
      - name: Build extension zip
        run: bash scripts/build_browser_ext.sh --with-app

      # AC1 (#1096): per-entry uncompressed size table + +5% budget gate
      # against the committed baseline (gh-1684: reseeded to the
      # post-#1631 vendored-engines shape — litert/transformers/webllm are
      # intentional CWS policy; growth beyond the floor fails the release).
      # Identical invocation as the PR-time gate (ci.yml
      # extension-size-gate): one baseline, one enforcement rule.
      - name: Size manifest + budget gate (fa-extension.zip)
        run: python3 scripts/size_manifest.py check build/fa-extension.zip --baseline scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv

      - name: Upload extension to the release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_PAT }}
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ needs.version.outputs.tag }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          asset="fa-extension.zip"
          cp build/fa-extension.zip "$asset"
          ls -lh "$asset"

          # Ensure the release exists (race-safe with release-macos). Title
          # is the bare tag vX.Y.Z (issue #282), latest is explicit.
          if ! gh release view "$RELEASE_TAG" --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            gh release create "$RELEASE_TAG" \
              --title "$RELEASE_TAG" \
              --generate-notes \
              --latest \
              --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" || true
          fi
          gh release upload "$RELEASE_TAG" "$asset" --clobber --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}"

      # Draft lifecycle invariant (issue #282): this job creates releases,
      # so a failed/cancelled run must not leave one behind as a draft.
      - name: Draft lifecycle guard (delete orphaned draft on failure)
        if: always() && job.status != 'success'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_PAT }}
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ needs.version.outputs.tag }}
        run: bash scripts/release_draft_guard.sh "$RELEASE_TAG"

  release-macos:

# (workflow_dispatch on the rebased PR head) is the pre-merge gate
      # and lands in this arm, so every validation runs the whole-tree
      # gates (crap4dart baseline, coverage ratchet, jscpd) — nothing was
      # ever main-only.
      - id: filter
        if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
        run: |
          echo "core=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "app=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "docs=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "shared=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      # PR classification runs through THE SAME classifier the pre-commit
      # hook uses (issue #194, AC7 + AC5/E2): one source of truth for path
      # rules, and the unknown-path safe default (full gate) — e.g. a new
      # dart_test.yaml at the repo root — now holds in CI, not only in the
      # hook. The selected stage set maps back to the same four groups the
      # old dorny filter emitted.
      - id: paths
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
        env:
          BASE_REF: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          HEAD_REF: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: |
          # ── Issue #1267 N1/N2 dispatch arm ──────────────────────────────
          # SM validation dispatches carry NO pull_request event context,
          # so BASE_REF/HEAD_REF are empty there: derive the validated diff
          # from git — merge-base(origin/main, HEAD) is the PR fork point
          # (the checkout above is fetch-depth: 0, so origin/main exists).
          # merge-base == HEAD (a main dispatch, or an already-merged
          # branch) diffs to nothing and the narrowed arms skip. A failed
          # resolve fails SAFE: both arms run unconditioned —
          # over-triggering a rare-path leg costs minutes, under-triggering
          # one hides a nightly-only red (the #1309 class).
          if [ -z "$HEAD_REF" ]; then
            HEAD_REF="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
            BASE_REF="$(git merge-base origin/main "$HEAD_REF" 2>/dev/null || true)"
            if [ -z "$BASE_REF" ]; then
              echo "::warning::merge-base(origin/main, HEAD) failed on the dispatch checkout — failing safe: exzone + locksmoke + installer + office_addin + extsize arms run"
              echo "exzone=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "locksmoke=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "installer=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "office_addin=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "extsize=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              exit 0
            fi
          fi

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,

build-extension:
    name: Build Chrome extension
    needs: version
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Ceiling for the daily cli watcher's budget arithmetic (#351).
    timeout-minutes: 30
    if: inputs.create_release == 'true'
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          # gh-1684 decision 4 (gate symmetry): the SAME exact patch pin
          # the pages.yml leg carried and the PR gate carries (#1431 —
          # the rev normalization absorbs canvaskit rev-hash churn, the
          # pin keeps every fa-extension.zip build comparable across
          # legs). The old unpinned `channel: stable` floated the engine
          # per run — one of the two ways the release and Pages legs
          # diverged.
          flutter-version: '3.47.7'
          channel: stable

      - name: dart pub get (root)
        run: dart pub get

      # browser_ext/dart is a separate package (path dep on this root), so
      # its pub get must follow the root's — same as browser-ext.yml.
      - name: dart pub get (browser_ext/dart)
        run: cd browser_ext/dart && dart pub get

      # Full artifact: SW agent (dart2js) + the Flutter panel app embedded,
      # exactly what "Load unpacked" expects. --clobber keeps the stable
      # asset name fa-extension.zip pointing at the newest build (the
      # landing page links it directly).
      - name: Build extension zip
        run: bash scripts/build_browser_ext.sh --with-app

      # AC1 (#1096): per-entry uncompressed size table + +5% budget gate
      # against the committed baseline (gh-1684: reseeded to the
      # post-#1631 vendored-engines shape — litert/transformers/webllm are
      # intentional CWS policy; growth beyond the floor fails the release).
      # Identical invocation as the PR-time gate (ci.yml
      # extension-size-gate): one baseline, one enforcement rule.
      - name: Size manifest + budget gate (fa-extension.zip)
        run: python3 scripts/size_manifest.py check build/fa-extension.zip --baseline scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv

      - name: Upload extension to the release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_PAT }}
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ needs.version.outputs.tag }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          asset="fa-extension.zip"
          cp build/fa-extension.zip "$asset"
          ls -lh "$asset"

          # Ensure the release exists (race-safe with release-macos). Title
          # is the bare tag vX.Y.Z (issue #282), latest is explicit.
          if ! gh release view "$RELEASE_TAG" --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            gh release create "$RELEASE_TAG" \
              --title "$RELEASE_TAG" \
              --generate-notes \
              --latest \
              --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" || true
          fi
          gh release upload "$RELEASE_TAG" "$asset" --clobber --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}"

      # Draft lifecycle invariant (issue #282): this job creates releases,
      # so a failed/cancelled run must not leave one behind as a draft.
      - name: Draft lifecycle guard (delete orphaned draft on failure)
        if: always() && job.status != 'success'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_PAT }}
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ needs.version.outputs.tag }}
        run: bash scripts/release_draft_guard.sh "$RELEASE_TAG"

  release-macos:

Read ticket files to understand WHY it changed and verify against requirements. ## 2. Diff checklist — apply to `pr_diff.txt` For every hunk, ask at least these questions: - [ ] Does the change match the ticket scope? Any scope creep? - [ ] Are new or changed public APIs contract-safe for existing callers? - [ ] Is user/external input validated, sanitized, or escaped? - [ ] Are secrets, tokens, or PATs handled safely — not logged, not interpolated into shell scripts? - [ ] Are new or modified files present under `testing/` in a non-test-automation PR? - [ ] Is dead code, unused imports, or obvious duplication introduced? - [ ] Are error paths handled, or are failures silently swallowed? - [ ] Are new dependencies justified and compatible with the existing stack? - [ ] Beyond blockers: what other maintainability, correctness, or quality improvements are visible in the changed code? ## 3. Changed-file deep read Do not review from the diff alone. Read the full content of every changed file: - imports and dependencies - class/method responsibilities and adherence to SRP / OOP principles - naming consistency with the rest of the codebase - error handling, logging, and edge cases - test coverage for changed behavior - backward-compatibility and migration impact ## 4. Severity classification Classify every finding before writing outputs: - **BLOCKING** — merge would cause a bug, security issue, data loss, or CI break. Must be fixed. - **IMPORTANT** — real maintainability or correctness issue. Strongly prefer fixing before merge. - **SUGGESTION** — optional improvement, style, or future polish. Does not block merge. When in doubt, start one level higher; downgrade only after confirming the risk is negligible. ### External-spec evidence rule A finding whose core claim is "**the spec / reference / ticket / external tool says or does X**" may be raised at 🚨 **BLOCKING** only when it quotes the exact source the review actually read during this run — a `file:line` reference or a doc URL. A bare "the spec says …" assertion is unfalsifiable for the author and for the machine, and a false one holds a validated PR hostage (live: a BLOCKING thread claiming an exemption list that the reference source did not contain — the reviewed code was behaviorally identical to it). Without a verifiable citation: - Downgrade the finding to ⚠️ **IMPORTANT**, phrased as a question: "Please confirm against `` — if confirmed, this becomes blocking." - Never let an uncited spec assertion be the sole reason for `REQUEST_CHANGES`. This is not a strictness cut: a spec-claim finding **with** a verifiable citation keeps full 🚨 BLOCKING force. ## 7. Exhaustive single-pass review Treat **every** review as the final and only review pass. The author will not get another chance to catch missed findings cheaply. - Do not defer SUGGESTION or IMPORTANT items to a later round because a BLOCKING issue exists. - After classifying all findings, re-read every changed file and ask: *"What else is improvable here?"* - Before writing outputs, verify that no obvious quality, maintainability, or correctness issue was left unreported. - Aim to surface the maximum number of actionable findings in this single iteration. ## 8. # (workflow_dispatch on the rebased PR head) is the pre-merge gate
      # and lands in this arm, so every validation runs the whole-tree
      # gates (crap4dart baseline, coverage ratchet, jscpd) — nothing was
      # ever main-only.
      - id: filter
        if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
        run: |
          echo "core=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "app=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "docs=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "shared=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      # PR classification runs through THE SAME classifier the pre-commit
      # hook uses (issue #194, AC7 + AC5/E2): one source of truth for path
      # rules, and the unknown-path safe default (full gate) — e.g. a new
      # dart_test.yaml at the repo root — now holds in CI, not only in the
      # hook. The selected stage set maps back to the same four groups the
      # old dorny filter emitted.
      - id: paths
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
        env:
          BASE_REF: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          HEAD_REF: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: |
          # ── Issue #1267 N1/N2 dispatch arm ──────────────────────────────
          # SM validation dispatches carry NO pull_request event context,
          # so BASE_REF/HEAD_REF are empty there: derive the validated diff
          # from git — merge-base(origin/main, HEAD) is the PR fork point
          # (the checkout above is fetch-depth: 0, so origin/main exists).
          # merge-base == HEAD (a main dispatch, or an already-merged
          # branch) diffs to nothing and the narrowed arms skip. A failed
          # resolve fails SAFE: both arms run unconditioned —
          # over-triggering a rare-path leg costs minutes, under-triggering
          # one hides a nightly-only red (the #1309 class).
          if [ -z "$HEAD_REF" ]; then
            HEAD_REF="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
            BASE_REF="$(git merge-base origin/main "$HEAD_REF" 2>/dev/null || true)"
            if [ -z "$BASE_REF" ]; then
              echo "::warning::merge-base(origin/main, HEAD) failed on the dispatch checkout — failing safe: exzone + locksmoke + installer + office_addin + extsize arms run"
              echo "exzone=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "locksmoke=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "installer=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "office_addin=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "extsize=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              exit 0
            fi
          fi

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,

build-extension:
    name: Build Chrome extension
    needs: version
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Ceiling for the daily cli watcher's budget arithmetic (#351).
    timeout-minutes: 30
    if: inputs.create_release == 'true'
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          # gh-1684 decision 4 (gate symmetry): the SAME exact patch pin
          # the pages.yml leg carried and the PR gate carries (#1431 —
          # the rev normalization absorbs canvaskit rev-hash churn, the
          # pin keeps every fa-extension.zip build comparable across
          # legs). The old unpinned `channel: stable` floated the engine
          # per run — one of the two ways the release and Pages legs
          # diverged.
          flutter-version: '3.47.7'
          channel: stable

      - name: dart pub get (root)
        run: dart pub get

      # browser_ext/dart is a separate package (path dep on this root), so
      # its pub get must follow the root's — same as browser-ext.yml.
      - name: dart pub get (browser_ext/dart)
        run: cd browser_ext/dart && dart pub get

      # Full artifact: SW agent (dart2js) + the Flutter panel app embedded,
      # exactly what "Load unpacked" expects. --clobber keeps the stable
      # asset name fa-extension.zip pointing at the newest build (the
      # landing page links it directly).
      - name: Build extension zip
        run: bash scripts/build_browser_ext.sh --with-app

      # AC1 (#1096): per-entry uncompressed size table + +5% budget gate
      # against the committed baseline (gh-1684: reseeded to the
      # post-#1631 vendored-engines shape — litert/transformers/webllm are
      # intentional CWS policy; growth beyond the floor fails the release).
      # Identical invocation as the PR-time gate (ci.yml
      # extension-size-gate): one baseline, one enforcement rule.
      - name: Size manifest + budget gate (fa-extension.zip)
        run: python3 scripts/size_manifest.py check build/fa-extension.zip --baseline scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv

      - name: Upload extension to the release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_PAT }}
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ needs.version.outputs.tag }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          asset="fa-extension.zip"
          cp build/fa-extension.zip "$asset"
          ls -lh "$asset"

          # Ensure the release exists (race-safe with release-macos). Title
          # is the bare tag vX.Y.Z (issue #282), latest is explicit.
          if ! gh release view "$RELEASE_TAG" --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            gh release create "$RELEASE_TAG" \
              --title "$RELEASE_TAG" \
              --generate-notes \
              --latest \
              --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" || true
          fi
          gh release upload "$RELEASE_TAG" "$asset" --clobber --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}"

      # Draft lifecycle invariant (issue #282): this job creates releases,
      # so a failed/cancelled run must not leave one behind as a draft.
      - name: Draft lifecycle guard (delete orphaned draft on failure)
        if: always() && job.status != 'success'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_PAT }}
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ needs.version.outputs.tag }}
        run: bash scripts/release_draft_guard.sh "$RELEASE_TAG"

  release-macos:

# (workflow_dispatch on the rebased PR head) is the pre-merge gate
      # and lands in this arm, so every validation runs the whole-tree
      # gates (crap4dart baseline, coverage ratchet, jscpd) — nothing was
      # ever main-only.
      - id: filter
        if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
        run: |
          echo "core=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "app=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "docs=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "shared=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      # PR classification runs through THE SAME classifier the pre-commit
      # hook uses (issue #194, AC7 + AC5/E2): one source of truth for path
      # rules, and the unknown-path safe default (full gate) — e.g. a new
      # dart_test.yaml at the repo root — now holds in CI, not only in the
      # hook. The selected stage set maps back to the same four groups the
      # old dorny filter emitted.
      - id: paths
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
        env:
          BASE_REF: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          HEAD_REF: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: |
          # ── Issue #1267 N1/N2 dispatch arm ──────────────────────────────
          # SM validation dispatches carry NO pull_request event context,
          # so BASE_REF/HEAD_REF are empty there: derive the validated diff
          # from git — merge-base(origin/main, HEAD) is the PR fork point
          # (the checkout above is fetch-depth: 0, so origin/main exists).
          # merge-base == HEAD (a main dispatch, or an already-merged
          # branch) diffs to nothing and the narrowed arms skip. A failed
          # resolve fails SAFE: both arms run unconditioned —
          # over-triggering a rare-path leg costs minutes, under-triggering
          # one hides a nightly-only red (the #1309 class).
          if [ -z "$HEAD_REF" ]; then
            HEAD_REF="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
            BASE_REF="$(git merge-base origin/main "$HEAD_REF" 2>/dev/null || true)"
            if [ -z "$BASE_REF" ]; then
              echo "::warning::merge-base(origin/main, HEAD) failed on the dispatch checkout — failing safe: exzone + locksmoke + installer + office_addin + extsize arms run"
              echo "exzone=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "locksmoke=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "installer=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "office_addin=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "extsize=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              exit 0
            fi
          fi

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config

build-extension:
    name: Build Chrome extension
    needs: version
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Ceiling for the daily cli watcher's budget arithmetic (#351).
    timeout-minutes: 30
    if: inputs.create_release == 'true'
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          # gh-1684 decision 4 (gate symmetry): the SAME exact patch pin
          # the pages.yml leg carried and the PR gate carries (#1431 —
          # the rev normalization absorbs canvaskit rev-hash churn, the
          # pin keeps every fa-extension.zip build comparable across
          # legs). The old unpinned `channel: stable` floated the engine
          # per run — one of the two ways the release and Pages legs
          # diverged.
          flutter-version: '3.47.7'
          channel: stable

      - name: dart pub get (root)
        run: dart pub get

      # browser_ext/dart is a separate package (path dep on this root), so
      # its pub get must follow the root's — same as browser-ext.yml.
      - name: dart pub get (browser_ext/dart)
        run: cd browser_ext/dart && dart pub get

      # Full artifact: SW agent (dart2js) + the Flutter panel app embedded,
      # exactly what "Load unpacked" expects. --clobber keeps the stable
      # asset name fa-extension.zip pointing at the newest build (the
      # landing page links it directly).
      - name: Build extension zip
        run: bash scripts/build_browser_ext.sh --with-app

      # AC1 (#1096): per-entry uncompressed size table + +5% budget gate
      # against the committed baseline (gh-1684: reseeded to the
      # post-#1631 vendored-engines shape — litert/transformers/webllm are
      # intentional CWS policy; growth beyond the floor fails the release).

        env:

          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ needs.version.outputs.tag }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          asset="fa-extension.zip"
          cp build/fa-extension.zip "$asset"
          ls -lh "$asset"

          # is the bare tag vX.Y.Z (issue #282), latest is explicit.

              --title "$RELEASE_TAG" \
              --generate-notes \
              --latest \
              --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" || true
          fi
          gh release upload "$RELEASE_TAG" "$asset" --clobber --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}"

      # so a failed/cancelled run must not leave one behind as a draft.
      - name: Draft lifecycle guard (delete orphaned draft on failure)
        if: always() && job.status != 'success'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_PAT }}
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ needs.version.outputs.tag }}
        run: bash scripts/release_draft_guard.sh "$RELEASE_TAG"

# (workflow_dispatch on the rebased PR head) is the pre-merge gate
      # and lands in this arm, so every validation runs the whole-tree
      # gates (crap4dart baseline, coverage ratchet, jscpd) — nothing was
      # ever main-only.
      - id: filter
        if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
        run: |
          echo "core=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "app=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "docs=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "shared=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      # PR classification runs through THE SAME classifier the pre-commit
      # hook uses (issue #194, AC7 + AC5/E2): one source of truth for path
      # rules, and the unknown-path safe default (full gate) — e.g. a new
      # dart_test.yaml at the repo root — now holds in CI, not only in the
      # hook. The selected stage set maps back to the same four groups the
      # old dorny filter emitted.
      - id: paths
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
        env:
          BASE_REF: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          HEAD_REF: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: |
          # ── Issue #1267 N1/N2 dispatch arm ──────────────────────────────
          # SM validation dispatches carry NO pull_request event context,
          # so BASE_REF/HEAD_REF are empty there: derive the validated diff
          # from git — merge-base(origin/main, HEAD) is the PR fork point
          # (the checkout above is fetch-depth: 0, so origin/main exists).
          # merge-base == HEAD (a main dispatch, or an already-merged
          # branch) diffs to nothing and the narrowed arms skip. A failed
          # resolve fails SAFE: both arms run unconditioned —
          # over-triggering a rare-path leg costs minutes, under-triggering
          # one hides a nightly-only red (the #1309 class).
          if [ -z "$HEAD_REF" ]; then
            HEAD_REF="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
            BASE_REF="$(git merge-base origin/main "$HEAD_REF" 2>/dev/null || true)"
            if [ -z "$BASE_REF" ]; then
              echo "::warning::merge-base(origin/main, HEAD) failed on the dispatch checkout — failing safe: exzone + locksmoke + installer + office_addin + extsize arms run"
              echo "exzone=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "locksmoke=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "installer=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "office_addin=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "extsize=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              exit 0
            fi
          fi

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary

build-extension:
    name: Build Chrome extension
    needs: version
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Ceiling for the daily cli watcher's budget arithmetic (#351).
    timeout-minutes: 30
    if: inputs.create_release == 'true'
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          # gh-1684 decision 4 (gate symmetry): the SAME exact patch pin
          # the pages.yml leg carried and the PR gate carries (#1431 —
          # the rev normalization absorbs canvaskit rev-hash churn, the
          # pin keeps every fa-extension.zip build comparable across
          # legs). The old unpinned `channel: stable` floated the engine
          # per run — one of the two ways the release and Pages legs
          # diverged.
          flutter-version: '3.47.7'
          channel: stable

      - name: dart pub get (root)
        run: dart pub get

      # browser_ext/dart is a separate package (path dep on this root), so
      # its pub get must follow the root's — same as browser-ext.yml.
      - name: dart pub get (browser_ext/dart)
        run: cd browser_ext/dart && dart pub get

      # Full artifact: SW agent (dart2js) + the Flutter panel app embedded,
      # exactly what "Load unpacked" expects. --clobber keeps the stable
      # asset name fa-extension.zip pointing at the newest build (the
      # landing page links it directly).
      - name: Build extension zip
        run: bash scripts/build_browser_ext.sh --with-app

      # AC1 (#1096): per-entry uncompressed size table + +5% budget gate
      # against the committed baseline (gh-1684: reseeded to the
      # post-#1631 vendored-engines shape — litert/transformers/webllm are
      # intentional CWS policy; growth beyond the floor fails the release).
      # Identical invocation as the PR-time gate (ci.yml
      # extension-size-gate): one baseline, one enforcement rule.
      - name: Size manifest + budget gate (fa-extension.zip)
        run: python3 scripts/size_manifest.py check build/fa-extension.zip --baseline scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv

      - name: Upload extension to the release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_PAT }}
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ needs.version.outputs.tag }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          asset="fa-extension.zip"
          cp build/fa-extension.zip "$asset"
          ls -lh "$asset"

          # Ensure the release exists (race-safe with release-macos). Title
          # is the bare tag vX.Y.Z (issue #282), latest is explicit.
          if ! gh release view "$RELEASE_TAG" --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            gh release create "$RELEASE_TAG" \
              --title "$RELEASE_TAG" \
              --generate-notes \
              --latest \
              --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" || true
          fi
          gh release upload "$RELEASE_TAG" "$asset" --clobber --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}"

      # Draft lifecycle invariant (issue #282): this job creates releases,
      # so a failed/cancelled run must not leave one behind as a draft.
      - name: Draft lifecycle guard (delete orphaned draft on failure)
        if: always() && job.status != 'success'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_PAT }}
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ needs.version.outputs.tag }}
        run: bash scripts/release_draft_guard.sh "$RELEASE_TAG"

  release-macos:

# (workflow_dispatch on the rebased PR head) is the pre-merge gate
      # and lands in this arm, so every validation runs the whole-tree
      # gates (crap4dart baseline, coverage ratchet, jscpd) — nothing was
      # ever main-only.
      - id: filter
        if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
        run: |
          echo "core=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "app=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "docs=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "shared=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      # PR classification runs through THE SAME classifier the pre-commit
      # hook uses (issue #194, AC7 + AC5/E2): one source of truth for path
      # rules, and the unknown-path safe default (full gate) — e.g. a new
      # dart_test.yaml at the repo root — now holds in CI, not only in the
      # hook. The selected stage set maps back to the same four groups the
      # old dorny filter emitted.
      - id: paths
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
        env:
          BASE_REF: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          HEAD_REF: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: |
          # ── Issue #1267 N1/N2 dispatch arm ──────────────────────────────
          # SM validation dispatches carry NO pull_request event context,
          # so BASE_REF/HEAD_REF are empty there: derive the validated diff
          # from git — merge-base(origin/main, HEAD) is the PR fork point
          # (the checkout above is fetch-depth: 0, so origin/main exists).
          # merge-base == HEAD (a main dispatch, or an already-merged
          # branch) diffs to nothing and the narrowed arms skip. A failed
          # resolve fails SAFE: both arms run unconditioned —
          # over-triggering a rare-path leg costs minutes, under-triggering
          # one hides a nightly-only red (the #1309 class).
          if [ -z "$HEAD_REF" ]; then
            HEAD_REF="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
            BASE_REF="$(git merge-base origin/main "$HEAD_REF" 2>/dev/null || true)"
            if [ -z "$BASE_REF" ]; then
              echo "::warning::merge-base(origin/main, HEAD) failed on the dispatch checkout — failing safe: exzone + locksmoke + installer + office_addin + extsize arms run"
              echo "exzone=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "locksmoke=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "installer=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "office_addin=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "extsize=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              exit 0
            fi
          fi

build-extension:
    name: Build Chrome extension
    needs: version
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Ceiling for the daily cli watcher's budget arithmetic (#351).
    timeout-minutes: 30
    if: inputs.create_release == 'true'
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          # gh-1684 decision 4 (gate symmetry): the SAME exact patch pin
          # the pages.yml leg carried and the PR gate carries (#1431 —
          # the rev normalization absorbs canvaskit rev-hash churn, the
          # pin keeps every fa-extension.zip build comparable across
          # legs). The old unpinned `channel: stable` floated the engine
          # per run — one of the two ways the release and Pages legs
          # diverged.
          flutter-version: '3.47.7'
          channel: stable

      - name: dart pub get (root)
        run: dart pub get

      # browser_ext/dart is a separate package (path dep on this root), so
      # its pub get must follow the root's — same as browser-ext.yml.
      - name: dart pub get (browser_ext/dart)
        run: cd browser_ext/dart && dart pub get

      # Full artifact: SW agent (dart2js) + the Flutter panel app embedded,
      # exactly what "Load unpacked" expects. --clobber keeps the stable
      # asset name fa-extension.zip pointing at the newest build (the
      # landing page links it directly).
      - name: Build extension zip
        run: bash scripts/build_browser_ext.sh --with-app

      # AC1 (#1096): per-entry uncompressed size table + +5% budget gate
      # against the committed baseline (gh-1684: reseeded to the
      # post-#1631 vendored-engines shape — litert/transformers/webllm are
      # intentional CWS policy; growth beyond the floor fails the release).
      # Identical invocation as the PR-time gate (ci.yml
      # extension-size-gate): one baseline, one enforcement rule.
      - name: Size manifest + budget gate (fa-extension.zip)
        run: python3 scripts/size_manifest.py check build/fa-extension.zip --baseline scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv

      - name: Upload extension to the release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_PAT }}
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ needs.version.outputs.tag }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          asset="fa-extension.zip"
          cp build/fa-extension.zip "$asset"
          ls -lh "$asset"

          # Ensure the release exists (race-safe with release-macos). Title
          # is the bare tag vX.Y.Z (issue #282), latest is explicit.
          if ! gh release view "$RELEASE_TAG" --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            gh release create "$RELEASE_TAG" \
              --title "$RELEASE_TAG" \
              --generate-notes \
              --latest \
              --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" || true
          fi
          gh release upload "$RELEASE_TAG" "$asset" --clobber --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}"

      # Draft lifecycle invariant (issue #282): this job creates releases,
      # so a failed/cancelled run must not leave one behind as a draft.
      - name: Draft lifecycle guard (delete orphaned draft on failure)
        if: always() && job.status != 'success'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_PAT }}
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ needs.version.outputs.tag }}
        run: bash scripts/release_draft_guard.sh "$RELEASE_TAG"

  release-macos:

# (workflow_dispatch on the rebased PR head) is the pre-merge gate
      # and lands in this arm, so every validation runs the whole-tree
      # gates (crap4dart baseline, coverage ratchet, jscpd) — nothing was
      # ever main-only.
      - id: filter
        if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
        run: |
          echo "core=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "app=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "docs=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "shared=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      # PR classification runs through THE SAME classifier the pre-commit
      # hook uses (issue #194, AC7 + AC5/E2): one source of truth for path
      # rules, and the unknown-path safe default (full gate) — e.g. a new
      # dart_test.yaml at the repo root — now holds in CI, not only in the
      # hook. The selected stage set maps back to the same four groups the
      # old dorny filter emitted.
      - id: paths
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
        env:
          BASE_REF: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          HEAD_REF: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: |
          # ── Issue #1267 N1/N2 dispatch arm ──────────────────────────────
          # SM validation dispatches carry NO pull_request event context,
          # so BASE_REF/HEAD_REF are empty there: derive the validated diff
          # from git — merge-base(origin/main, HEAD) is the PR fork point
          # (the checkout above is fetch-depth: 0, so origin/main exists).
          # merge-base == HEAD (a main dispatch, or an already-merged
          # branch) diffs to nothing and the narrowed arms skip. A failed
          # resolve fails SAFE: both arms run unconditioned —
          # over-triggering a rare-path leg costs minutes, under-triggering
          # one hides a nightly-only red (the #1309 class).
          if [ -z "$HEAD_REF" ]; then
            HEAD_REF="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
            BASE_REF="$(git merge-base origin/main "$HEAD_REF" 2>/dev/null || true)"
            if [ -z "$BASE_REF" ]; then
              echo "::warning::merge-base(origin/main, HEAD) failed on the dispatch checkout — failing safe: exzone + locksmoke + installer + office_addin + extsize arms run"
              echo "exzone=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "locksmoke=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
